/byerdo :the/ re:rto /bye/ /spros /ji/ nag chu byang gas pa rgyus dpyad gagri po'i tshe phra ragasadab sa skra/1 dang thog yul sde'i ming thogs stangs zur tsam gleng ba/ ( 1)1 byang rigs tsho pa'i thog ma'i grub gzhi'i skor/ (6)3 byang rigs shog kha so so'i byung tshul rags zhib sna tshogs sgor/ (9)4 byangarigasatsho pa'i spyi'i dbang sgyur dang / dpon rigs bye brag pa'i skor/ (28/5 byang rigs kyi dpung sde dang so srung 'char canadomag rtsis bcas kyi skor/ (46)ca byang rigs tsho pas 'jal dgos khral gyi skor/ (56)7 byang rigs tsho pas 'dur dgos 'u lag gi skor/ ( 65)8 byang rigs kyi 'go pa'i za sgo dang khral chag (70)

zur 8)sde dzejordo ngaX/ ( (7—— cha 9 ram̐ zang sa/ pa( pa rgas 'apya nga za / / ra mi risna‘ — /sgyu( jig ma sdoju༄ —rig re(10 'unyebye/ga na phra rags ba gras 'a skra/ngang thog lul lde'i ming thogs snyangs zur tsam speng ba/da lta nag chu sa khul gye nag chu rdzong dang / ma mdo rdzong gnyis kyi khongasagatoḍa sa sde 4 sngogadus bar skabs shig ring / chu byang rigs sam byang rigs sde bzhi zer ra/ra yod/ der shod tshul gcig ni gzhung sog sto byang dang bar tha/ a mdo/ gsang gzhung bzhi la brtsi yi yod pa red/nga nga 'ba' res ba/zhung sog lho byang dang sger pa bud pa'i gsang gzhung dang bar tha/ a mdo/ hor smad bcas bzhi la brtsi mkhan yang 'dugachu byang rigs zhes pa ni rgya rma jul chu'i chu phugs te nag chu gtsang po'i rtse stod kyi lho byang rgyud la gnas yod pas de ltar 'bod par grags la sa der gna' nas yod pa'i zhang zhung pa'am yar lung pa/ bar skabs nas chags pa'i sog rigs sogs tshang ma byang sar gnasabacas pa'i yulasde der dus phyes rgyun du stabs bde'i sgo nas byang rigs zhes zer gyi yod par mngon/ nag chu'i lte ba'i grong ming skor la/ bar skabs nag chu grong pa thog mar chags skor nas der dbu sgar ram/ o

rgod zer ba dang se hrug grong zhes 'bod kyi yod pa red/ 'dir shod tshul me 'dra ba yod pa ste/ khag gcig gis dbu sgar zer ba dang / de yang sngar gling rje ge sar gyes bdud klu btsan 'dul lam 'dir bzhugs sgar rgyag phyong ba'i dbu gur phub sar grong pa chags rjes ming de 'dra byung chul ga gleng ba dang / yang khag gcib gis lta ce la dbu sgar zer/ lha sgrung la mi nga gyur ba sngar 'de khul sdod gnas khang pa ba/tan nas chang /samed skabs kyang rgya sob/ bod kyi 'gyur bzhud ba 'dus yin stab sa de ga'i da pon rigs gur ra brten narngag gnas sdod byed kyi yed nga/sa na de nga zhe she'i ri/nga snan nas dbu gur sgar zhes thogs ba yin nges slam yang kha shas rgya yodabu /)/ ces/ //| 1byen /sdus 1(1/bye( /spen /sdus lag tsho sgar na pa da 4ra ba ga ska da ga ba/ na shas cha 'ad sde/da sa dang lung par sog ska da kyi ming mang po yod pas na 'di yang de 'a/sa ma 'das bsam mkhan yang radug se hrug grong zer don nag chu' rjo nga nang so mkhan nang dang zhabs brtan dgonapa chags rjepo/ khris su spra gur ser gur phub mkhan khyim dud 'ga' zhig yod 'dug pa se hrug ces ming 'dornga chags pa red zer rgyuna'adug nag chu zhes pa ni chu byang rigs chags yulagatsang chu'i ming de lte ba'i sa gnas la spyar te 'bod ming ri+obazhin chags pa yin 'dug 'di'i skor gong gsal blo mthun gzig4pa pos dpyad pa gnang 'os 'a/gas/gnyis ba thog mar byang rigs thog kha'i kha grang lam tsam/dmangs gtso gsar brje'i sngon tsam la tshad byas na byang rigol 2

shog kha 5ngayod pa 4 / (1) bar tha sger gzhung dgu yod pa /sger tshu ji ///to ri pa zer ba sku drag dang / dgon sde khag gi mi ser la zer ba dang / zhung zhes pa bod sa gnas srid gzhung ge mi ser la zer ba yin )'bu thar shog them grangs 90dang / dbyis chen 70 dbyis chung 45 ru chen 154sde gsar 127bcas gzhung sde shog kha 5dang / sger sde gung skor 50dang / rig spyi 30 g.yu thog 30 stag sde 2ribacas shog bzhe yod/(2) gsang gzhung la sger gzhung dgu yod pa gzhung shog drug ste/'a ba shog them grangs 318 dmar yongs 110 so che 170 thog ru 80 sems dpa' 150 bkras ljongs 70bcas dang / sger brtse gser gdung dkar ru 20 sems dpa'arta rje ma75 dga'aldan ru ba 85bcas gsum yin (3) gzhung sog lho byang bcu gnyis zer ba ste/ lha ma shog drug ni/ e ni ru ba them grangs 55 lho marang shog 4ra nang so ru ba ca0 me mdel ru ba 42 shog rnying ma 1༷yongs 'dzin ru ba 18bcas red/ byang ma shog drug ste/ stag ring thegagrangs 130dang / stag gsar 50 a gong ru ba 50 ba ring ru ba 30brgya darnganaru ba 30 bya rigs ru ba 9bcasadrug yin/ (4) sger pa shog brgyad ces u gtog them grangs 150dang / khri ba ru ba 105bstan rgyas gling 50 kun gling 10 gra tshang ru ba 13 gser khang ru ba 15 rgya maru ba 11 rdo ring ru ba 70 (5) hor smad shog baṃzhi ste/ ru rnying them grangs 140dang / ru gsar 100che 'bum 100 'khor mang 70bcas bzhi yin/ (ca) a mdo3

thog brgyad bcas a mdo stod ma them grangs 1000skor dang / a mdo smad ma 140 ser dor ru ba 150 bkra ru 190 shog chem ma 10 0 rgya mtsho ru ba 210 shog chu ba 110 ga bya 100bcas brgyad yin/gong gsal ni byang regs ru drugakyang zer/ je'i khar bla brang rtsar 0ga char 4 phyoṭa mtho —3 1sgogasum gya ma sar ta nga 0 sar mas grangs 140 dang / gru ba khang mi ser 250 khang se/ra sdu/ se ra ca4 bca༄ shog gsum snan nga /'i shog kha 5nyayod nga ca zad sngar 'damargya shog brgyad kyi/ khong sa/ nga na pa'i byang shog gsum zer ba ni/ an ṇag dang 'angam gangu ga dpyi ga sum zhes 'ja zu/ kha themakhagrangs 14 0 dang / g.yub/ tha ca0 dpye tha 1'u0bcas shog gsum dang lho shog yam chi bcaca ba'i yod pa sna na na cog kha 5 yod pa red/gong gsal byang rigs yul sde de dag la khyon them brangaspolnga stong bdun brgya skor yod 'dug ( rgyus yod mi sna rnying par zhib 'dri byas pa'i grangs tshad yin/ )gong du gzigs nges bde ba'i ched du nagachu'i yu'akhasde'i sdon ming tsho grangs lam tsam ngo sprod zin rjes pyang rigs tsho pa khag chagasabyung gi gzhi rtsa'i lo rgyus dngos 'kha'ajug par dang po/ sa yulagyi skor/byang rigs tsho pa'i chags yulani nag chu'i lte ba byang rigs kyi 'dzorang 'du za phung lta bu red/ 'dir rgya mtsho'i ngo+olas spyi khri—bzhi stong lnga brgyamasamatho ba'i sa ra chags yod stabs/ cung saskabams mtho ba'i

'brog khul khe gtsang zhig yin pa der saca che la/ mi grangs nyung ba bca4 kyi khyad chos yod/ sa babs mtho ba'i rkyen gyis mkha' rlung nyung ba grang ngar che ba/ lo ltar cha snyoms kyi drod tshad dma' ba/sad se ra rgod pa/ char du4thung la gangs dus ring ba bcas yin/ yula'adir gser dang / tshwa las gtso4 pa'i gter dngos dang / sa 'og tsha nus sogs yo da/ gangs la me tog 3/sa gtsos sma na rtsa dang / khrung khrung giyogatsos 'dab chags/ gtsod 'grong yi/sa gtsos pari ri dwags/dbyi dkar dang / dred kyis gtsos ga 4 na gzan rigs so sa/sa sna tshogs yod pa red/ grags can gyi ri bo ni/ khyung spru la rnam thar nang gsal ba ltar/ a mdo'i sgro gad zu ga mo/ byang gi jam lha ri dmar/ nam ra btsan rgyal smugapo/ skyu nga gi rdzug gu ma tho paṃ/ gsang phu'i bsam gtan gangs bzang / byang gi rdza pon yol po/ tho/ ra'i brag che na 'khor po/byang gi tsig gi bya kyung / de bzhin dkar gyi ṅka/ la dar mdung dang /lo yi lo phu zhal dkar/ zi dro rgyal ba thod dkar/ kong gi ga pa ga ma bcas mang tshogs nang grags pa can gyi ri rgan ming can du 4yod/ rgya mo jul chu'i chu phugs su grags pa'i a mdo mtsho nag dang tsi gi dar — mtsho/ 'brong mtsho/ ne ri bul mtsho sogs grags yod kyi mtsho dang /ming thogs tsam gyi mtshe'u ni shin tu mang po yod/ nye rabs lo brgya yas mas la mtshon na/ spyir btang nag chu byang rigs kyi sa yul rgya bzho ni/ nub 'brong mtsho nas shar shag chu kha bar dang / lho a yer la nas byang ba yan la tshad gsum pa bar yin pas sa 'brel shar dang / shar 5

do sdon gyi hor tsho dang 'brel/ lho dang sto nub 'bri gung dang / ra sgreng gi sde dang 'brel/ nub dang nub byang sa skya dang chos 'khor gan3 ru'i sde la 'brel/ byang dang byang shar mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sa khongs dang 'brel ba bcas yin/‘radir sngar gye dus su gtan di da kyi sde dud nyung ngu las med paras cha mang che thos la rkya nga 'brong ri dwags kyi gling lta bu yod 'dugadaper na/ g.yug gi rgyud la 'brong sngo chu ma zer ba'i khyu tshogs yod rabs gleng rgyun yod pa dang / gsang gzhung gi sa spa chab gnyis 'brong gi pha yul red/ 'ol shi gnyis rkyang gi 'gro lam red zer srol yod/sa cha mang por klung gzhung du ri dwags kyi lam rjes dus deng sang yang bsda da yod pa ma zad ri khrod du sha 'brong gi rwa co btsa' bo gang sar yod pa dang / gna' mi'i mdel lcags btsa' brgyab pa yang mthong rgyu yod pa red/gnyis pa byang rigs tsho pa thog ma/ri grub gzhi'i skar/gna' dus sa yu' 'dir lo rgyus yig cha'i nang ji bzhin 'khod med rung zhang zhung 'go pa'i sgo phug bar ma dwang ra 'om bu'i khongs dang / phye ma—gsum glang gyims shod (steng chen rdzong )dbar gyi sa yulayug rgyud gcig la mkha yod stabs zhang zhung 'go pa'i khongs su yin par snyam la/ 'ang zhungastong rgyud mthu chen bzhugasayul sgrub gnas gnam mtsho'i do gling la yin4 pa yongs grags dang cor khra bo bkris zer ba khyi ra ba yod rabs bstan 6

'dug 〈〈mna' bshags nyon mongs kun 'joms las 〉〉gna' nas /rtsi/ /15 /(1 reX/ 1—1 1)rdo /tshe//bye/ the:mi6nang sdonang ngas /sna bzhi 'o/—ga pa dang / ya ga rten ba lta bu skye la mkhan 'ga' zhig bcas 'brog sde nyung ngu zhig yod 'dug pa las rbad de sa stong yulastong zhig min pa bstan 'dug bcings 'grol zin rjer nag chu khul gyi byang ngang shar nub kyi rjo nga kha shas kyi sa 'og nas thon pachi gna' mi'i rus bgyur ram/ yo chas kha shas btsal rted byung yod pa des 'di khul yang lo stong tsho du ma'i gong nas mi'i 'gro ba chags yod pa ཿdor dngos tshan rig gi thog nas gsal ba shad byung yod pa reng/ de min 'brog pa dmangs khrod kyi sgrung gtam nang du'ang byang gi ri thi ri dkar dang / ri dmar tshang zer ba sogs mang po shod rgyun yod pa dag mgazhi sgrung yi da rung lar nas gzhi med ce ga ma yin par/ byang rgyud du ri 'i/'i 'tsho ba skyel mkhan yod par phyisargyan spros sgro btags kyis sgrung gtam du gyur ba zhig yin par nges/ 'on kyang byang gi ri shi'i skor la nye ba'i dus rabs su'ang cung thag ring ba'i byang gi mi med klung khrod du dud tshang rezung byang 'brog dmangs ma dang 'brel ba rbad de chad nas lo grangs mang po'i ring mi med dben khrod du ri dwags kho na rngon nas 'tsho ba bskyal te sdod mkhan mthong cho sa su gyur ba yod 'dug pa 'dis byang tsho'i spyi tshogs lo rgyus 'phel rim la dpyad gzhi phran tsam yod srid snyam/ yang nag chu'i 'brog pa bgresasang gi kha rgyun du/ sngar byang rigs 'di gu ge rgyal po'i khongs su gtogs pa dang / de rjes thang pa khri skor (stag lung )pa'i khongs red zer srol zhig 'dug 'di'i thad sngar bod khri skor 1

bcu gsum zer ba'i nang thang pa khri skor zer ba ma thos/ 'a dburngo༄ ngh+ru rtse 7 〉nga drug gi nang thang po che zer ba zheg ya da/ de yang rta /ba rargya nga ༅ 4 du 4 nag thang po che zer ba de yim pa las 'di rgyud dang nye bar ma yin/ stagalung ni byang sta ga lung dgon pa ma yin/ dbus gtsang mtsham sa kyi nga/ra 'brog stag lung khri sko ra zer ba'i stag lung de las sa/khyan la mi go bachu/ shod rgyun 'a di don dang gtan nas gab mi 'grig par snang / 'on kyang sngar mi'i shod sgros de dpyad gni spu tsam med pa dor rkyang byed rgyur ma rtsis par/ de'i nang bsam blo gtong sa'i dbya da rgyu phran bu yong re'i shod srol de'ang rang sor bkod pa yin/ de bzhin da dung ge sar sgrung gi nang 'di yul ke ru'i klu btsan rgyal po'am bye ri stag rtse rgya' po'i khongs — — yin tshul mang po gleng yod/ bdud gling sgrung dpe zhig gi nang 4stod ltar sgo ri khra man chad/ shar nag lha 'dzaca/ pa yan chad/ lho lha ri sgang rgyud tshun chad/ byang dpa' gzi gangs dkar tshun chad/ ke ru'i klu btsan rgyal po'i mnga' khongs yin tshul dang / 5dkar mo lug gling la bdud sgar brgyab/ 'bu tho ri dmar gyi nub phyogs la gling sgar brgyab tshul sogs 'dug 'on kyang sgrung ni sgrung gi nang don las ma 'das pas lo rgyus dngos kyi dpyad gzhir bgrangs bar mi 'os kyang dmangs khrod du sgrung srol khyab che bas zlang tsam zhig byas pa lags/gnan yang byang rgyud 'dir gan snga mor zhang zhung pa'am de nas pur rgyal btsan po'i dbang sgyur rjes rur ba'i skor tsho thar thor yod — par mngon la/ rjes sor bod btsan po'i gdung rabs kyi rting ma mnga' 8

risasu gyar te sde btsug mgon gyis gu ge bzung ba'i mjug gi dusa'am nang du'ang snga rting gis gu ge nas nag chu'i rgyud du chas nas chags — pa ni gsang gzhung 'a wa shog kha yin tshul lo brgya thub pa'i mi med kyang bska lapa stong gi tshig yod zer ba'i dpe ltar sngar gtam gleng rgyu 'dug kyang sngar pur rgyal btsan po'i gdung rabs kyi smad char phyogs khag la 'thab 'khrug zam mi chad pa rgyag pa'i skabs sam bod sil bur 'thor skabs yul dus kyis rkyen pas yar lung pa'i tsho pa'am rus rgyud 'ga' zhig byang sar chags gnas byas yod pa'i lta tshul shod rgyun yang 'dug ('di'i rgyabarten gyi lung gsal po ma shes )de bzhin tsha dam bye thang du gyur rjes sto da sog bodaspos zer ba dang / lhag par bod sil 'thor gcig gyung gyi yon gong ma'i skab4sam dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang sog po gu shri han (bstan 'dzin chos rgyal )gyis sde srid gtsang pa'i srid dbang 'phrog ste bod khams dbang sgyur byas rjes kyi snga rting nas sog po 'bor chen bod du yong nas kho tsho'i pha yulagyi gom gshis ltar sbra gur phub nas bod byang phyogs su khyim gzhi chags te yun ring gnas mus bod byang 'brog gi cha shas su gyur yod pa'i shod rgyun yod pa red/gong gsal rnams ni dus phyis 'bod pa'i nag chu'i byang rigs tsho pa zhes pa 'di'i snga phyi'i yulasde'i grub gzhi de yin/sasum ba/ byang rigs shog kha so so'i byung tshul rags zhib sna tshogs skor/(1) bar tha sger gzhung dgu ni byang rigs kyi sngar yod sde 9

zhig yin par nges nam ra gro ma'i brag dkar gyi steng du gna' rabs kyi mkhar rdzong shul da lta mthong rgyu yod pa yin (da lta a mdo shan stong mchod chus khongs sdon bar tha sde gsar nang yod )nang gses kyi shog ming snga ba ni hab chags zer ba'i sa char chags yod pa'i 'bu thar shog kha yin pa dang de nas ru chen dang / dbyis chen yin pa/ de rjes dbyis chen shog kha mang du phyin nas nang ma 'cham pas dbyis chung zer ba'i shog kha zur du gyes pa bcas kyi shod srol yod pa ma zad/ rjes sor mdo smad nas yong ba'i sde dum zhig bar thar mgo btags nas gzhis chags pa de sde gsar pa yin pasasde gsar zer gyi yod 'dug gzhung tsho lnga de ltar yin la/ sger tsho bzhi ni dang thog bar tha'i jing ger gyi blon po gung pa tshang nas kho rang gi 'gab 'khor dud bdun bcas/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi bla phyag las khungs la mgo btags nas sger sder gyur pasaphyes gung skor zer ba dang / stag sde ni mi phuḍa bar tha nas yin pa'i byang stag lung dgon pa'i grwa pa skya babs rna mas sger rag shag gis shugs brgyab ste zhib gzhung lhan lnga sbrel zer ba zhig gi thog nas stag lung gi khongs su gtsang chod song bas de nas bzung stag sde zer ba'i sger par gyur 'dugagayu thog ni bar tha'i mi drag ga 'bas zer ba zhig gis sde gsar gyi khongs nas dud 'ga' zhig sger g.yu thog gzim shag la mgo btags pas kho rang la g.yu thog dpon ga 'bas zer ba'i ming thogs pa de nas bzung sger sde g.yu thog zer ba byung yod ('di phyis su yin )ri spyi ni phyis 'bras spungs spyi gso stag kha ral sbyin pa dri med can nas sngon sngag 0

pa de thog mar mdo smad rmar khams nas yong ba yin pasan rmar yong/ zheni pa'i tsho pa'i ming thogs pa red zer / de min gsang gzhung rgyud du phyogs gzhan nas sde 'thor 'ga' zhig rug rug byung nas gzhis chags yod pa de la 'thor ru ma zhes sngon ming byung rung rjes su sgra 'gyur nas thog ru zhes—zer/ gong gsal shog kha gsum de gsang gzhung gi gzhung sde 'a rmar thog gsum zer gyi yod/ de min so drug che ba zer ba'i shog kha zhig yod pa de so hrug zer ba ni nor lug gnyis kyi ming yin pa dang / sde de tā la'i brgyad pa'i skabs tsam la gzim shag hor khang gas ra zhabs pad la 'khyol ba'i dus skabs yas mas su she 'dzin gyi sger sde yin 'dug kyang rjes su gzhung sder gyur 'dug sems dpa' shog ni bod kye sprul sku rnam gsum gras lo sems dpa' bla spyon pasalha sa'i skyid chu'i chu log bablogs pa'i grub rtags bstan skad la de'i legs gsor rgya bod bla dpon nas dpon nyi ma shar tshad sems dpa'i sa/ chu thur du 'bab tshad semasadaba'i chu zhes pa'i ha cang che ba'i sa khyon sems dpa' bla brang la sprad dus de tsam che na khral mi khyag zhus/ 'dam gzhung sems dpa' la sprad zeradus/ sems bras go rig mthong skyid dgra sdang nyi ma lung / sreb la pho sprang brgya yi rgyun mi chad/ nyin la mo sprang brgya yi rgyun mi chad / me dgos zhus/ khyod gang 'dod dris par byang mu rne gangs rgan/ ba ra tha'i re sde lung sngon/ chos 'khor gyi mchod rten gzhung dang / dkyel 'khor sding / ko khrab/ 'o the/ gnam mtsho'i tsho mjug nya chu lho byang / dag po mtsho srib dang / la rgan be khu dmar mo/ rka tshen /2

skabs dge bshes blo bzang 'phrin las byang du dgon pa 'debazhe 5 par phebs ska ba sa 'khor shog chen brgyad kyi sa khongs 'khor a ba dpon dang /mchod yon 'brel te de ga'i nye 'gram du rong po dgon thog mar phyag btab rnga/ dang / dge bshes gshegs rjes/ yang srid btsal nas rong ngo chos ngo sku — 4/ nga da nga 4/ byung pa dang / dado re dus skab/ na chu ro nga — / dgo na pa'i thun bdag snu ru bzhi yi 'gro / ga pa brer ba ngakhor shog brgyad nang nas byung rma dag ‘bla dgon gyi sger sde lta bu zhig yod tshul dang / de nas nang chen dud bdu na zer ba bla dgen gye mgo btags sger sde sna 6da pa byung ba dang sbraḍa rim 'phel gyis rjes sor rong po me ser zer ba byung ba red/ rong po mi ser de'i sa ni 'khor mang gi sa yin pa sngar lam bka' gtan nang yod 'dug pa blo mthun nyi ma 'od zer gyis mthong byung zer gyi 'dugakhang ser bla brang gi sger ge byung tshul ni lo rgyus cha tshang tsam shod rgyu yodang/ ste de yang mtsho sdon neng chen khongs kyi nang chen sde pa'i rgyud du sngon du sa rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dang po'i thos ma'i lo dus skoral sbas yul lam yig ces pa'i darje dum cig byung ba'i nang du lho nub phyogs su sa thag ring tsam so nga bar zhing khams 'o rgyan sbas lung zer ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can la ngo mtshar che ba'i 'dod nyu'i longs spyod yod pa ste/ sheng she sha dang / 'o ma'i chu 'apo// tre ma'i rtsam pa/ shing lo'i me to ga 'dab ma'e gos sogachu rtsol sgrub mi dgos pa'ilongs spyod gang dgos spyod rgyu yedapa ma zad/ gcan gzan byes byams sems byed pa/bya bye'u yis ma ṇi 'dren pa'i gsung snyam thos rgyu yod tshul sos/sa 'khod4 24

pa'i yig dum zhig byung ba de dag la yid ches kyis blo ling gis bkal nas —ru 'bug brag zer ba zhig dang / kurma dar rgyas/ er/ rje sgrub chen dang /sgrub chung zer ba bcas /gyim dud bzhis sa zhing dang / sbra mkhar blos btang nas ru shog bros byol gyis gdong lho nub la phyogs nas song song ji/sa mtharaphangasacher dmigs sa'i yul la slebs tshod tsam la de ga'i yul mir skad cha dris lan 4na rgyan sbas lung zer ba phar phyogs shing gseb tu brag dkar po dang / snge ri dkar po de tsho red/ khyed tsho'i re ba ltar 'dod yon de'adra yod rgyu ltar ba(ra ga sa 'dir gnas sdod kyang byed mi thub zer nas rgyu mtshan bgrang bar kho tsho yid thang chad nas gang sar 'khyam dgos byung mthar bod sheng 'brug 1904lor a mdo mtsho dmar du 'byor zhing /de dus khang ser sku dre nga gnyis pa bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor 'das ma thog yi na paca ru 'bug brag gi bu ngag dbang dang / kurma dar rgyas bcas dngul mgar malas yo shes kyi yod sta bas bla ma'i sku gdung bzhe ngas mkhanabyas te de gar yun reng bsdad rjes khang ser kya/ga mdzod nas khyim dud de bzhi bla brang gi 'ang ba dud sger sde bya rgyur lha sar ser byes brgyud zhus don don cu nagabyung nas sger sde byung rjeru slar yang nang chen nas gong dud bzhi'i nye 'brel mas/ra ba bkra shis kyis gtsos dud 'ga' zhig snon 'phar byung ba ma zad/ de nas yang dems ji rag shus skor ba zer ba dang (dud kha shas )nag shod botha phan nas phyug po sga ba khag rdza dmar/ che 'boms bcas nas dud chung khral tsho ma zin pa dang / nang ma 'cham pa bcas kyi 'khyamasangasdod byed mkhan 'ga' zhig kyang khang ser bla brang la mgo 25

btags/ des ma tshad ma mdo stod ma'i bar skabs shig gi grags can mi sna gur 'bum smad g.yul rgyal zer ba des kho rang sger la mgo btaḍa pa'i ru dud kha shas yod pa de yang khang ser sprul sku la zhen che stabs mchod sde yin zhes phul des kyang ma tshad sngon chu rta/ 1941lo yas mas su mtsho sngon rma chu tshang gis dems ji nyer lnga'i khongs kyi sde sheg 'ga' zhig la dmag don gtor brlags byung skabs bros byol yong ba'i yug shul dang / yag ra'i ru dud /ba shas dang / yang de'i gong tsam nas bros gyar yong ba'i mi sa go thang zer mkhan gye/ khram skor gcig am stod kyis gtor bsad byas yod pa'i lhag 'apro dud tshang khag gcig dang / am stod smad kyi ru dud kha shas shig kyang khang ser bla brang gi sger sde'i khrid du 'dres nas de'i khongs gtogs su gyur pa bcas byung 'dug rjes sor khang ser sger sde de yang gzhung mdzod sbug gi mi ser du gyur pa'i brgyud rim zhig kyang yod pa red/ ('og tu brjod rgyu ) khang ser bla brang gi sde ni a mdo stod ma dang smad ma'i bar du yod/sgrub khang mi ser sheng stag lo 1914lor sgrub khang sku phreng lnga pa blobazang ngag dbang bstan 'dzim rgya mtsho nas da lta'i zhabs dgin ༷ 'du khangadang / bla brang gi thog khar rgyal ba'i gzim chung byang chub mngon dga'i pho brang bcas mnyam bzhengs rjes bla brang ba/zim khang du dadu ra dus wa kha thig 'tshag dang / dgun gangs 'phyag rgyu/ rgyun du gad phyis gtsang spra byed mkhan bcas dgos gnad che gshis las sgrub dud yan 'ga' zhig nyar—'thus chog pa bka' shag la snyan phul don smin byung bstun thog 26

mar ser hrug grong pa'i nang nas pho yan mo yan zhes bcu phrag kha shas this larganapo gcig gi do dam 'og gong gsal las skul gyis mi ser du gyur pa dang / song nas bka' gtan btsan dmigs yod stabs rim bzhin nye mtshungs 'brog ste nas kyang mgo btags mi ser je mang byung 'dugathem dud de dag ni nag chu mkhan nang gi khrims zhabs nas bla brang gis khag theg byas te blus pa'i mi dang de min khyim du dbul po 'ga' zhig bla brang sa nas she blangs te she 'og sbra phub byas pa dang / ga0/na yang khams dud 'ga' yas bla brang la ma go btags zhus pa'i mi bcas yin pa mi rtsa mang che ba gzhung sog lho byang khul nas yin pa dang dpon khungs so so'i 'khrol 'dzin thob pa'i khyim dud yin 'dug de tsho'i chags yul ni/ gzhung sog lho byang nang dang sger rdo ring ru ba'i rgyud bcas gang sar yod pa gartsa bo shar nub gnyis la yod/ gong gsal bla brang gsum gyi mi ser byung snga rjes dang / gnas yulatha dad yi na pas 'go pa niso so'i bla brang thos bskos mngaḍa byas pa'i dpon nam/ rgan po tsam las lo rgyuca thob/ thob thang che ba 'di zhes med nga/ra mngon/ 'on kyang rong po mi rtse/ra gyi ban dkar brgya dpon dang / khang ser mi ser mdzod sbu ga la phul 'jags rjes kyi dpon po bcas cung thob thang che bar snyam/(8) an khog 'jam g.yug dbyi gsum dang/ lho shog yamachi bcas bzhi ni bcings 'grol ma zin5gong 'dam rgya shog brgyad kyi khongayoyin pasar lta 'dir grangs 'dren tsam las 'dam rgya shog gi spyi 'dre tsam yin gathis nga tshor rgyus mnga' zhi0 par med pas ma bkod/27——— — ———

bzhe pa/ byang rigs tsho pa spu'i dbang skur rang dbon — rigs bye brag pa'i skor rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta/ 1543lor gu shri bstan—'dzinachos rgyal kyis dbang sgyur byas pa nas/ khong gi yang tsha lha bzang khang ma bkrong bar dang / jun gar tshe ring don grub pas bod ljongs dbang bzung byas yun nas ching gong ma'i dpung chen gyis jun gar mi bsun pa tshar bcad nas bod kyi gtso bo da'i ching sba dur (khang chen pa )gyis srid skyongaba'i ring bcas su nag chu'i byang rigs khul 'dir gtso bo sog po'i dpon rigs kyis dbang sgyur byed kyi yod par mngon/ sog dmag kyang phon chen bca' sdod byed kyi yod 'dug khang chen pa nga lum sbyar gsum gyis bsad rjes nag chur khang chen payomangaḍa gtong byas pa'i dpon rigasara'i sang dang / mkhan po tshar bcad pa'i gnas tshul〈〈mi dbang rtoḍa brjod 〉〉la gsal 'dug rgyal ba lnga pa'i gsung rnam nang du'ang ‘ nag chu'i sog dmag spyi bsdus ’’zer ba yang yang gsal gye yod pa dang / lha bzang khang gi skabs nag chur sog dmag gi 'go pa nang so zer ba dang po byung tshul shod rgyun yang 'dug lha bzang khang dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'ibar gyi 'gal 'khrug mtha' gcod kyi skabs su lha bzang khang sog yul la 'gro khul gyis nag chu nas sog dmag bskongs te slar log nas sde srid bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul yod pa sogs la dpyad na gang ltar nag chur sog po'i dpon dmag nges can zhig gtan sdod kyis dbang sgyur byed kyi yod 28

'dug snyam/ wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal am ban gyis tshar bcad rjes chanalung khri lo 15pa/ 1751lor ching rgyalarabs srid sa/thung gis bod kyi las don byed phyogs skor gyi 〈〈sgrig yig don tshan bcu gsum 〉〉zhes pa'i nang don gcig la mnga' ris dang nag chu bcas kyi sa rnams gnad 'gag shin tu chen po yin 'dug pa zhib dpyad ltar na nag chu 'dir mtsho sngon po'i sa 'dres dang / mnga' ris 'di jun gar dang sa 'dres yin 'dug de dag la 'go pa bsko bzhag bya rgyu de nges par du blos 'khel zhing go chodapa'i mi bdams nas bzhag na sa gnas la phan thoḍa pa yong gi red/ sngar nas mi rnying khungs ming graḍa yodapa rnams bdams nas gtong rgyun ltar tā la'i bla ma la zhus te/ 'dems gtong byed dgos zhes gsal 'dug derabarten lung 'di'i thog nas nag chu'i sngar gyi mkhan nang zhes pa'i dpon rigs dag bod bzhugs ching gong ma'i blon chen gyis gros bton bzhinatā lar zhus nas krab krargatig tig gis gtong gi yod pa bstan 'dug yonag chu dang mnga' ris gnad 'gagarnachen po yin don nag chur phyi'i rgyal khab dang sa 'brel med rung mtsho sngon po'i khongs nas skabs 'digli snga rting skor nas ching wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gtsos pa'i dpon riḍa nyung ngu zhigagis gong ma'i srid gzhung la drin lan log 'jal gyis ngo log ste shin cang gi jug gar pa dang ngan 'brel byas nas bod la'ang gtser bsun bya rtsis bcangs kyi yod pa'i gnas dus de 'dra la brten nas bkod par mngon )byang riḍa kyi 'go pa mkhan nang zer ba de dang po dus tshod ga dusabyung ba gzhi 'dzin yig rnying sogs ma 'byor rung thos rgya cung zad yod pa'i 29

bgres song 'ga' zhig gi go brgyud lta tshul byas na/ mkhan po zer ba de byang gnas lha sde spyi'i 'go pa lta bu'amayang na sa byi ga mo che tshun gzhung 'bri bzhag pa'i she dpon dbyar dus nag chur 'ong ba de dga' ldan pho brang pa'i mngaḍa gtong ming 'dzin dpon rigs la chos kyi go ming dgos stabs mkhan po zhes gzhung zhabs ser mo ba re gtong ba dang / nang so zer ba ni so ga po gu shri han mi rabs gsum gyi dbang 'dzin ring mtsho sngon sog po nang log nas mtho gong ma'i sred gzhung la rgyab kyi phyogs shing bar gu shri han rang la dgra zlar blta ba'i tsho khag 'go gtso re zung yodapa de ga'i dpung shugs bod lhags yong dogs dgra zon mel 'tshe mkhan byang dam4/ 'go pa nang so zhes pa'i sog po'i dpon rigs bsko sa mngaḍa byas pa'i ming thog nas rim pas nag chu'i byang rigs kyi spyi'i 'go pa zhig tu gyur yoda'adug pa ste/ de'ang tshod dpag byas na dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i lo 'go tsam la rgyal po lha bzang khang gis nag chur rta dmag 'jugs skabs byung ba min nam snyam 1814lor zhabs dgon thog mar sgar pa nas dngo/na par sgyur skabs nang so de dga' bzhi rdo ring pa'i sku tshab nas byed kyi yodapa zhabs dgon bka' gtan nang gsal 'dug don du ching rgyal rabs kyi g.yung kring khri lo lnga pa nas man 'ju'i mtha' mjub/ gi gong ma shon thong khri lo gsum pa'ibar bod bzhugs am ban rim pa'i skab4nag chu mkhan nang gong 'khod ltar gtong gi yod par mngon/ 1911lo lcags phag gsar brjes ching rgyal rabs srid gzhung gtor ba dang / krung hwa rgyal dmangs srid gzhung 30

btsuḍa pa'i lo dus kyi nang du bod la btsan rgyal ring lugs pas 'dri lag brkyang nas zhi drag bya ngan rim spel byas pa'i nyer len gyis nang khul kha bral— ba nyung ngu thon pa dang / rgyal gces dang kha bral bar gyi 'thab rtsod ril pa ltar chaṇa kyi nang du nang gnas stobs shugs la brten nas rang rgyal krung dbyang srid gzhung la res btud res rgol gyi rnam pa'i dus gnas dpyid kyi nyi ma ltar gcig tu ma nges pa'i yuladus nang du nag chur gong nas mngags pa'i 'go pa mkhan nang zer ba gnyis po yang rdzong dpon gyi thob thang thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung rang gis chab srid kyi dgos dbang la gzhigs nas gtong gi yod 'dug de nas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu rta 1943lo nas bka' shag srid gzhung gis nag chu mkhan nang rdzong rim nas spyi khyab rim pa'i sgrig gzhir bsgyur nas byang rgyud spyi khyab zer ba bod sa gams srid gzhung gi rim bzhi serarnaskya sbrel po re bsko 'dzugs byasayod pa des bka/sa bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi steng gi bkod pa mjug ma sgril bar du byang rgyud spyi la dbang sgyur byas pa red/ byangaspyis nag chu rdzong khongs tsam min pa byang rgyud spyi khyab khongs stod nag tshang nas smad khyung po steng chen bar gyi rdzong gzhis bco brgyad tsam gyi 'go 'doms ming 'dzin byed kyi yod 'dug gsham du gong gsal sa gnas srid gzhung skabs btang ba'i nang so dang (bgres po'i ngag rgyun ltar nges tshod tsam las tshang ma min pa 'dra )byang spyi rim thog tu byung ba'i ming 'dren tsam byas na/ nang so gzhung zhabs lcang ra'i yab rgan dang / lcang ra sras/ de nas rkun bzang rtse/ de nas 'jam dbyangs dkyil/ de 31

nas ra sgreng rgya bo bcas tsam dang / byang spyi dang po mkhan chung pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang / rim bzhi gsum mdo ba rgyal mtshan yon tan/byang spyi dus rim gnyis pa mkhan chung lha'u rta ra thubabastan bstan dar dang / rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa (mda' dpon byed mi de yin )byang spyi dusarim gsum pa/ tsha rdo ra'i mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po (rgya nag mkhan chung yang zer )dang rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan gnyis/ byang spyi dus rim bzhi pa/ mkhan chung rgya mtsho bkra shis thub bstan byang chub dang /rim bzhi smon skyid gling 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ byang spyi dus rim lnga pa/ rim bzhi sman stod blo bzang dbang 'dus dang las tshan thon zur blo bzang bstan 'dzin bcas so/ da dung byang rigs 'dir sdon ma'i khargyun ltar na/ nag chu mkhan nang zer ba de ma byung ba'i sdon du 'diphyogs kyi spyi'i 'go pa che shos ni bar tha'i jing gingadapon chen yin 'dug 'di pa hor jing gir rgyal po'i mi rgyud/ byang pags zhwa can gyi rgyal po 'am/ byang ste re sgo can gye rgyal po (lho shing sgo dang byang re sgo zer )zhes gleng srol mi mus rgyud bcas su 'jags 'dug yang sog dus thog ma'i skabs nag chu'i rgyud kyi 'go pa gtso bo ni bar tha'i jing gir dang /de 'og las rogs ru rnying stong dpon/ gsang gzhung spyi khyab/ a mdo'i stong dpon lho byang gi brgya dpon gnyis bcas lhan drug sbrel zer—ba de yin rabs yig rnying nas mthong myong gsung mkhan 'dug bar tha'i jing gir ni yon rgyal rabs gsar 'dzuḍa mkhan gnam bskos rgyal po jing gir gyi gdung rgyud yin pa che bshad shod srol yod pa red/ byang mi rgan gras 32

lo rgyus la shes rtogs cung byed mkhan gyis brjod srol la dpyad na dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang jing gir rgyal rgyud rgyal po go dan gyis bod la dmag btang nas bod ljongs yongs rdzogs gcig gyur sil 'thor mjug sgril rjes kyi dus tshod nang jing gir gyi rgyal rgyud nas chas pa'i dpon riḍa bod byang gi 'go ba gtan 'jags byung ba nig yin par brtsi yi 'dugayang jing gir btsan lha ga yul rgyal yan mi rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba red zer rgyun 'dug de'i bu kun dga' da lta nag chu sa gnas srid gros kyi uyon yin / dus phyis tsam la skad grags cung zad yod pa'i jing gir rgya zing zhes pa ni g.yog mo zhig la skyes pa'i jing gir gyi mi rgyud yin pa dang /de yang jing gir mi rgyud chad grabs skabs kong tsha'i stong dpon zer bas jing tshab byas pa ma zad kong tsha'i bu zhig jing gir gyi mi rgyud yin zer rgyun byung gshis skabs der ru chen brgya dpon ru 'brug rgyal zer bas kong tsha'i bujing gir mi rgyud ma yin par jing gir tshang gi g.yog mo'i bu zing rgya1zer ba jing sras 'khrul med yin tshul bshad pas de don kong tsha stong dpon dang khamachu thug nas nag rdzong sbrel por zhus shing rdzong mkhan nang nas kong tsha'i rgyab byas pas kong tsha khe/ ru 'brug rgyal nas ma nyan par lha sar gzhung gtuḍa byas/ kong tsha tshang gis skabs der sku drag la skyel rgyu'i dngul rta rmig mang po khyer yod pas sgo la'i la la drel nyal ba red zer srol byung ba dang de skabs kyang kha mchu ru 'brug rgyal pham/ ru 'brug nas sku drag gi zhabs gras rnams la/ mdo la khrims mi gda' rung / sbug la khrims yod shag byas te yong ba yin 'dir yang khrims mi 'dug pas/ mdo sbug gcig 33

pa red lab pas/ zhabs gras nas brgya dpon lags de 'dra ma gsungs /gzhis ka gtan 'jags dang / gzhis gnyer brje len zer ba'i dpe degasan ma myong ngam mi tshos sgo la'i lal kong tsha'i drel nyal gyi 'dug zer gyiyod pas na ga ler gsag bskor dgos pa las yid thang chad rgyu med zer bar 'brug rgyal nas de bden par go nas smyug sri nga nas stabs skor zhu 'bul byas pas slar khong tshar 'gug rgya phabs thub pa byung 'gug rgya thabs kyi 'brel ba dang zi gas nas skyel ba dang bo/nga tsha sto nga dngo na lha 'gug thi/sa ting ma'i gyod thag bcad par/ ru 'brug rgyal rgyad khe bas skabs 'dir lha sa nas log mkhan bar tha'i mi la lan bskur te rgyal po blon po thug dus blon po khe thal ma ṭam ru ṭa thug dusaru kra khe thal/ 6ga ma la chang 'tshod lab rogs zer ska da gleng rgyu 'dug de nas jing gir rgya zing khri 'don byas pa dang / lha sgrom/ zer ba3na' ma bsus pa de /spa dang po bu mo ma gtoḍa bu ma byung stabs sog sde ting ngu bon dgon gyi sprul sku la zhus pasagaser 'od nor bu 'od 'bar khri sgo phyes na bu skye yong gsungs par de ltar byas pas skyi da skyid skabs lha sgron la bu byung ba rjes ma'i rjes ma'i jing gir dbang 'dus phun tshogs red zer sro/la 'dug yab 'das rjes tā la'isku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya nag nas yar phebs skabs a ma lha sgro na nas jing gir bu khrid de mjal kha zhus nas bu la ming zhus pas dbang 'dus phun tshoḍa zhes btaḍa gnang ba dang go gnas gnang ba red zer rgyun 'duga'adir tā la'i bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar la bltas nas dgung sgrig dus brjod tshul de ji bzhin yin min nges pa mi 'dug hor bar tha'i stong dpon 34

gsar pa gnyis la mjal kha gnang zer ba dang / yang bar tha spra che na tshang dang kong tsha a leb soḍa la sger mjal gnang zer ba las 'khod mi 'dug pas dpyad par mdzod/ jing gir dpon chen la hor dam sdig rwa dang / chosa'abyung zhes gru gsum snol ma zhig yod pa dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs byang rigs stong brgya'i nang gi gral gnas gong ma gnon mkhan dang /lha sa ra dom dom nyis brtseḍa brgyab chog la chibs g.yog gnyis khrid chog pa'i tha'i ji'i go sa'ang yod 'dug dpon tshang 'di par sngon hor bshan pa dmar po'i tshe skra dang go khrab yod 'dug pas la las hor sdig cago bshan pa'i mi rgyud red ces gleng rgyun 'dug kyang tshe skra go khrab rig gan4gsar brje'i nang gtor brlags zin nas med/ smad ma shog ba'i'i ru rnying stong dpon ni 'khor tsha'i mi rgyud yin pa ste 'khor tsha ma yin hor tsha yin/ hor jing gir rgyal po'i mi rgyud yin/ gri shed las les bar ma'i ya bdag yin zer rgyun yod pa'i mi rgyud ngo ma hor yin pa dang dpon rabs bco brgyad song ba shod srol 'dug 'di tshang gis phuḍa lha gnam mthel bsten gyi 'dug pas hor rus yin pa gdon mi za/ 'on kyang rjes sor tsho dpon spyi 'dres ltar las sngar gyi stong dpon zer ba ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur 'dug a mdo'i stong dpon zer ba ni a riḍa khar kha rgyal po'i gaja'i rus rgyud nas byung ba yin tshul shod rgyun 'dug la yang rje tsong kha parga.a mdor chags pa'i a riḍa dud bdun gyi nang gi rgan khog tshe bum gnangasa'i rgan mo der nam zhig lus sbrum nas bu kha sho zhig btsas pas ming btsan skyabs zer (de btsan rol pa'i rdzus bu yin par rtsis )rus ming 35

yang ga rgya mi dmar btsan gyi gdung rgyud btags skad/ btsan skyabs la budrug byung bar ga ja stag drug zer zhing skabs der bod sa gnas kyi srid 'dzin pas a mdor ga ja bu drug nas gcig dpon por bsko dgos stabasadam phrug gi kha ris btsan los la blta dgos pa'i spun drug gi so so'i thel rtse khyer shog gsung4par bu chung ba'i dam phrug gi kha ris sdig pa ra tsa yin stabs dam ris btsan zhing bu de'i gzugs dpyad la gzhigs nas ming la srin po ra nyag btags nas am dpon du bsko sa / de'i bu stong dpon lha mo skyabs zer gyi yod pa dang / de'i bu stong dpon bstan 'dzin zer gyi yod 'dug bstan 'dzicha gyi bu bsam 'phel nor bu dang / chos grags gnyis byung ba 'di gnyis kye tsho dpon tsam las stong dpon byas medapa dang / de gnyis kyi bu mgon po dang / rgya mtsho zer ba gnyis byung bas chung ba rgya mtshos stong dpon byab// rgya mtsho'i bu stong dpon don rnam gyis sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtsho la dad sems chen po byas pas byang a mdo khul du phebs dgos luḍa zhus / khong gi sku dus suthebs mi thub rung / skye srid rjes mar phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba dang /na bza' tshos gos dang rten rtsal (a mdo sbra chen tshang la yod pa red )stong dpon 'di pas da dung sdon stong dpon lha mo skyabs kyi skabs sbra chen tshang gi bka' gtan she bam blangs pa de'i rgyab snon kyang lha sar rgya bod bladapon mdun sa nas blangs yod pa red/ don rnam gyi bu a jo dang /mab grags gnyis yin pa/ a jo'i ming gzhan tshe ring chos rgyal zer ba 'dis stong dpon las khur blangs ring sgrub khang blo bzang tshul khrims 36

bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gying phebs gdan zhus kyis zhabs dgon dang /gnas mo dgon gyi dbu bla gnang / zhabs dgon gyi smon lam bca' yig dang gnas mo dgon gyi bka' shog mdzo bzos ma ’zer ba de yang stong dpon 'di pas blangs skad/ spun chung ba ab grags kyi bu stong dpon pad+ma dgra 'dul yin/ 'di'i bu stong dpon dbang grags rnam rgyal gyis am sde dgon bcu gsum gyi spyi khyab byed rgyo nga yod/ de nas bzung a mdo stong dpon zer ba byung myong med pa red/ a jo'i bu jo jo dang /de'i bu gso kho 'dis sto nga tshab zer ba byed dzu nga / a mdo rgya mtsho ru pa'i dpon yin/ de 'i bu bsod rgyam de'i bu 'phrin rgyam da lta nag chu sa gnas srid gros kyi u yo 0 yin gsang gzhung spyi khyab ni dang thog stod nas mar chas pa'i gu ge'i rus rgyud nas byed kye yod 'dug de yang 'a ba shog gi nang nas yong gi yod pa dang / dus phyis dpon ming nges pa ni' ba 6gab chung zer ba dang / de'i bu rnam rgya' 'gyur med/ deri bu'ajiḍa med dgra 'dul/ de'i bu dpa' bo dgra 'dul bcas so sos spyi khyag byas chul tsam 'dug dpa' bo dgra 'dul gyi tshe smad du/ ‘‘gsang 'a dmar gsum gyi shog kha de stag lung brag srid skyong skabs stag bla'i sger sde ru gyur pa dang yang de'i gong nang khul gyi zlos gyar zhig la brten gsangaspyi khyab spyi go sa 'pho 'gyur byung nas ba ra zhes par gsang spyi byung ba dang —yang de'i rjes sor 'pho 'gyur gyis gsang rting ma blo gros zer ba yin/bgres sordza de da lta nag chu sa gnas srid gros kyi u yon yin/gsang spyi'i mi rgyud dpa' bo dgra 'dul brjes nas gsang spyi mjug ma —37

rnams 'jon thang go 'pher gyis sde spyi'i sems 'khri che ba'i mi drag cig byang spyis bsko ba3ga byed kyi yod 'dug gzhung sog lho byang gi brgya dpon gnyis sog dus sog rgyud yin 'dug rung rugi rgyud che ge mo zhig gtan 'alel me da par lto byang khul nas 'a ge pa 'gar nig pho su rgod dpon ri ba sgo ba/ rta su mgyogs gral la btags nga'i dpe ltar byed srol yod 'dug ‘ — na kyang brgya dpon kha shaṭa mi rabs ga)sa gsum reng rgyunamathud pha rjes bu 'jug byas pa yang yod pa/ dper nas gang ba rgya dponabasod ra ba tshang dpon rabs gsum lta bu red/ byang brgya a gang ba'i rgyud 'dzin thub chos (da lta sa gnas srid gros kyi u moca yin ) rte/ ma'i brgya dpon shes blo'i bu blo mazum rta mgring/ dbang rgyal (byang tsho'i lo rgyuba'adi'i rgyu cha'i ma zin gnang mkhan yin pa )bcas yin/ dpon rigasabyebrag pa/(1) gzhung sog lho byang du brgya dpon gnyis phud pa'i nang khul shog kha so sor 'go pa rda ro kha re yod pa (rda ro kha ni sog sgo'i skad yin pas dpon ming zhig )dang de'i 'og tu rnga /na po re gnyis ma re yod pa yin/(1) bar tha gzhung rgyug tsho pa lnga la brgya do/na bcu dang sger tsho baṭ+wāṃge la rgan po re re yod/ gung pa shoka la rgan po'ithob/ tu gung pa tshang gis dpon byed byi yod pa'i 'di tshang pha rgyud bu 'dzin gyis nang gur sko ra ba'i dpon gnas 'dzin zhing phyi'i bar tha sger gzhung dgu'i nang gi dpon chen jing gir ba'i blon po lta bu'i thob thang 'dzin gyi yod pa 38

red/ bar tha'i dpon rigs byings rnams jing 'i/ra dang gung pa phud gzhung sog lho byang dang 'dra bar mi rgyu gnyis 'dzoms kyi sus 'jon brgya dpon rgyad pa zhig yin/ da dung bar tha'i nang bar skabs jing tshab byed myong ba'i 'byor phyug mi drag gam/ sger btsan kha dbang che ba 'ga' zhig byung myong yod/ sngo na kong tsha a leb zer bas sde pa gzhung gi 'bas pad bshad sgra la rgyab rten bcol nas bar tha jing gir dpon la kha gtad bcag nas dgra gyod byas pa'i gnas chu la sgrung gtam 'dra ba zhig kyang thos myong /(3) gsang sger gzhung dgu'i gzhung tsho drug la brgya dpon dru ba/ yod pa dang / sger tsho'i /ser gdung dkar ru la she dpon zer ba ṇ+ḍig sems pa rtar rdzi ba'i dpon la rtswa dngo na zer/ dga' ldan ru bar spyi mi zer ba bcas yod pa yi na/ gsang gzhung gi 'go pa rnams kyang spyir btang gsang spyi 'a ba gu ge'i rus rgyud tsam byas pa las tshang ma mi su 'a jon mang mos 'os 'dem sa lta bu byas pa zhe gcig red/ sger gser rdung dkar ru'i dpon dang po gser rdung sbra chen tshang thog ma'i mi rabs skabs la khrims sgo rang btsan gyi go sa yod par mtshon pa'i khang sgo g.yas g.yon du stag dbyugs dang gzig dbyugs bkal rgyu yod skad red/mi rabs kha shas song ba'i rjes gser rdung gi bu skal bzang yar 'phel dang go mag chos skyabs can nas 'bri gung 'pho ba chen mo'i dus chen la 'gro bar snyad btagasanas 'dam gzhung nas sde dge pa bam si ti bla brang gi ja bdal 'phrog bcom byas pa dang de nas stod phyoḍa kyi mdzod sbrug’ 39— /de/ —— — — —/de//de/

she 'bri jag 'ded sogs kyi bya ba ngan pa ripocan byas rkyen mthar byang spyi lha 'u rta ras bod dmag skul nas gser rdung sbra chen tshang nye 'brel ltos bcas shul med du btang ba red/ 'di'i rjes nas gser rdung dkar /bye/ /ste/ 151 khyedro rtse/rdo /rje/ ma ci /bye/ 'u rgaru da na ra ba su/ 'a na ba lan lta bu da pa las dud nga gcig gis rgyud 'dzitsha dpon byed rgyu med par gyur 'dug(4) spyir btang a mdo shog brgyad la dpon brgyad yod pa dang mang che ba ga ji rus rgyud kyis dpon byed pa dang / stong dpon dbang grags rnam rgyal rjes su stong dpon zer ba byed mkhan ma byung rung a mdo stod ma sa thag 'gyangs shing sde rgya che la dpon rgyud btsan stabs byang spyi dang po pha lha'i ska bas su dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul la spyi khyab kyi ming gi gzengs bstod pa dang de'i rogs par ga ji rus rgyud kyi dpon zhig dang mi rgyud la ma ltos pa'i dpon las bya zhes pa sde nang nas drag 'dems byas pa'i dpon rogs re bcas stod ma tsho par dpon che chung gsum yod pa dang de rjes spyi khyab dpon rgyal po zer bas byas shing /de rjes rin chen g.yang 'grub skabs spyi khyab mi zer bar spyi dpon zer ba dang / las rogs dpon ni klu zog spun gnyis kyis snga rting gis byas yod pa dang / dpon rting ma klu zog nor bu bsam 'phel da lta bsda da yod/(deng skabs sa gnas srid gros kyi rgyun ud/) am stod la da dung byang spyis bskos pa'i dmag dpon zer ba kha shas yod pa dang / de minadapon ming dngos gsal med rung dbang cha ha cang che ba'i mi drag ming po che kha shas byung yod pa dper na gur 'bum pad+ma g.yul rgyal zer ba 40

dang / gung dpon nyi rdur zer ba/ klu zog rdo rje tshe dbang zer ba stong pa'i dbang nor zer ba lta bu byung yod/ lhag par du gur 'bum pad+ma g.yul rgyal ni byang rigs smos ci hor tsho so dgu dang / dems jinyer lngar skad grags yod pa zhig red/ gur 'bum bho rdur dang / klu zog rdor tshe gnyis nang ma 'grig par bho rdur mgo skor gyis nang bsad byas pa dang klu zog rdor tshe can yang spyi khyab skal dgram nas mgo skor nasamig byas pa bcas kyi gnas tshul byung yod/(5) hor smad shog bzhir dpon bzhi yod pa spyir btang rus rgyud yin/ 'khor tsha'i rus rgyud yin pa'i ru rnying stong dpon mi rabs mang po phyin rjes su ru rnying du khang tsha dgon zhes pa btab mkhan chos zhus bla ma zer ba zhig yod pa de mtsho la 'phang nas rkyen bsad byas pa zer ba'i zlos gyar la brten stong dpon tshang gi dpon gnas phabs nas ru rnying dpon gnas 'bo tshe ring lug 'phel nas blangs pa dang rjes sor byang spyi zhwa sgab pa'i skabs yang skyar kha mchu zhig gis rkyen byas tshe ring lug 'phel can dpon sa phabs nas sngon gyi stong dpon khyim rgyud yar 'phel zer bar ru rnying dpon gnas byung yod pa red/ che 'bum dpon dang po long rgyud dang la sa sbrel dpon ho ra dkar mi rgyud nas byas yod pa dang / che 'bum dpon hor dkar a rgyas zer ba'i skabs rong pomi ser dang gyod thug byung ba'i ban dkar brgya dpon gyis yang yang bstun rung ngan gnad gang ches tshod ma zin stabs mthar gdong bsher skabs lha sa nas dam rdzus bzos pa'i rdzun rkub rdol te gyod phams 'khel ba dang sbraḍa41—————— —/de/——/de/

dpon gnas dbyung btang ba red/ de nas bzung che 'bom dpon long rgyud tshang la las sprel mgar ba tshang gis byed kyi yod 'dug che 'bum nor lha (nor rgod kyang zer )dang / gnam sras skar mthar/ ga tso bdag (rting ma de yin )bcas byung yod/ nor lha zer ba'i che 'bom dpon der khyad chos khyad mtshar zhig yod pa ste/ sde dpon kha mchu dang nang khul gyi blo 'don gros 'dri/ kha ta bslab bya'i don skor sogs kyi gal che'i gtam gle /nga dgos rigs mtha' dag tshig bcad glu tshig gi brda don /lo na glu ru len nas brdzod kyi yod pa las tshig lhu ga gi gtam 'don byed srol med pa zhig yin 'dug che 'bom dpon long rgyud dang las prelamagar ba'i na/ bas che 'bom dponamagar long gnyis zer ba'i bsdus ming chags yod pa re — do/ 'khor mang dpon dang tho ka 'khor dga' rang ༷do na dkar zer ba zheg yod tshu ba dang / de nas 'khor shog chen brgyad de ma rab dpon tshang nang/ dbang bsgyur mun ring byas pa dang / 'bru rong po zer ba'i mi rgyud nas dpon byed kyi yod skad kyang 'dug dus phyes tshetho su 'jon gyis dpo na sa 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ ru gang ra dpon ni ru rnying stong dngo na rgyud 'dzar gyis go mag byas pa'i mi rgyud nas dpon sa 'dzin gyi yod pa zhig yin 'dug hor smad shog bzhi la dpon gyi 'og turgan po mang rabs shig yod pa red/(5) sger pa shog brgyad nang sngo rdo ring brgya dpon zer ba thob thangache skad dang / khri pa dang / o thog gnyis la dpon re re yod pa dang / de min tshor 'go pa rgan po re re yin pa 'di rnams kyang 42

drag 'dems res skor yin 'dug(7) bla brang gsum gyi mi ser 'go pa ni rong po mi ser sngar snu ru bzhi yi 'brog pa dang nang chen dud bdun bcas kyi skabs 'go pa rban po gnyis tsam las med phyis sde rim 'phel gyis rgan shog bzhi la gyur nas rgan po bzhe dang spyi dpon gcig yod cing / bar skabs dpon ni ban dkar a myur tshang gis mi rgyud nas dpon byas pa ban dkar brgya dpon tshang zeraba'i mi rabs mang tsam byung / khang ser bla brang mi ser la dang po rgan po zheg gis 'aso/ pa byed kyi yod pa de'ang ru 'bug grags zer ba de yin/ 'di'i mi rgyud kyis rgan po yun ring byas rjes sde mang du phyin pa dang bstun nas am stod dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul gyis 'dam nas yin pa'i blo bzang bzod pa zer ba zhig khang bla'i mi ser gyi dpon du bskos pa dang de rjes bla brang phyag mdzod skya babs rin chen dar rgyas nas dpo na lo shas byas/ de nas lo du ma'i ring dpon 'di zhes med rung rgan chen blo bzang rab rgyas nas 'ango/ pa byas/ de rjes am stod spyi dpon rin chen g.yang 'grub nas khang bla'i mi ser chags sa am stod sa khul du yin pa dang / sde rgya che ru 'gro yi yod pas khang ser rin po cher dmigs bas la tog tsam gyi zhabs zhu sgrub rgyu phud kha sde yi/ mdo stod ma spyi 0dre ltar gyi khral sgrub dgos tshul gleng brjod spel nas byang spyir snyan 'bul byas par brten khang ser bla phyag dang / rgan po rab rgyas/ dmag dpon bstan grags bcas bgros nas rang med rogs med ltar khang bla la mi ser ma byung rung am stod kyi khral khongs mi 'jug 43

zer nas khang ser bla brang gi mi ser de bzhin tā la'i bcu bzhi pa sger la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu dang sbrags phyag mdzod lha skyod byas pa'i phyir phebs sger khang mdzod sbug mi ser byas 'thus khar slad mi ser gyi spyi 'doms dpon zhig dang rgan po gcig dgos pa'i 'os tho dgos lugs kyang phebs gshis rgan po blo bzang rab rgyas kyi go mag klu zog nor bsan gyis am stod dpon gcig lcogs dang / blo bzang rab rgyas kyi bu bkra bsam gyis rgan po bya rgyur 'os tho snyan phul ji bzhin byung nas rjes sor khangabla'i mi ser de mdzod sbug si/ mi ser du gyur pa dang / dpon gcig dang rgan po gcig byung yo da pa red/ sgrub khang bla brang gi mi ser 'brog sde gang sar 'thor nas bsdad yod rung gtso bo shar nub gnyis su/ gnasayod gshis so sor rgan po re re yod 'dug ser hrug grong pa'i pho yan mo yan zer ba'i sgrub bla'i mi ser la las skul sogs byed mkhan rgan po gcig yod pa red/ sgrub bla'i mi ser gyi rgan po rnaza4 sa ni bla brang gis drag res bsko 'dzugs byas pa zhig las mi rgyud 'ded pa sogs ma yin/gong gsal byang rigs tsho pa'i dpon rigs ni mdor na rus rgyud 'ded nas bsko ba dang / rus rgyud mi 'ded par drags 'dems gong bskos byed pa gnyis red/ rus rgyud kyi dpon po 'u na ring byas pa der lo rgyus kyi snyan grags cung che rung rgyud 'dzin mi thabs sdug zhig tshar na 4pha khu bo tsan dan sdong po la/ bu tshar rgyud chu shing gi yal ga sogs zer zhing rnyas bzhag zhog gi yod pa red/ dmangs khro nas byung ba'i pho 'jon thang can zhig tshar nas des dpon gnas 'dzin bar pho 44

rang byung rdo rje rang nas byung na dga' ldan khri la bdag po med zer ba ltar dang 5sha mo spang khug red zer dpon thog de rang la ngo bstod byed pa red/ rus rgyud kyi dpon ni bar tha'i jing gir/ hor jing gir rgyud pa/ de bzhin a mdo'i stong dpon ga rgya'i mi rgyud/ gsang gzhung spyi khyab gu ge'i mi rgyud/ ru rnying stong dpon hor tsha'i mi rgyud sogs lta bu dang / rus rgyud mi 'dod par sus 'jon dpon bskos ni lho byang brgya dpon gnyis kyis gtsos mang che shos de red/ de tsho ni spyir btang kha shas lo shas nas brje ba dang / 'ga' re tshe gang dpon gnas bzung ba bcas sna tshos/sa las gcig tu ma nges/ tsho dpon bsko bzhag byed stangab ya nga dpon gnas mtho dma' la gzhigs nas che bar rgya bod bla dpon nas go gnas gnang gi yod pa dang / 'bring bar byang spyi 'am nag chu rdzong mkhan nang nas bsko ba/ chung ba so so'i khongs kyi dpon chen nam stong brgyas bsko ba sokho/sa yica 'duga'adir byang rigs dpon rigs kyi sko ra rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa'i rnam thar ka pa'i nang nas drangs pa ste/ rab byung 13pa'i me yos lor tā la'i sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho khams mgar thar nas bod du phebs pa'i lam bar shag chu kha ru phebs mtshams nag chu'i byang rigs kyi dpon 'go rnams chibs bsur bcar 'dug pa'i 'di ga'i dpon ming nang 5dza sag tha'i ji no yon kho sho chi/ ha tsha bar rda'i tha'i ji bzhi /ma'u o tog gi dpon chung drug gzhung sog rda ro kha bco lnga/ a mdo'i dpon bzhi/ 'bo rong dang rong po dgon gyi bla grwa zhes sogs 45

'khod 'dug gong gsal gyi ha tsha bar rda'i tha'i ji ba'i zer ba 'di'i thog nas bar tha'i jing ger de tha'i ji'i go gnas yod pa bsta na 'dug snyam la da dung de 'dra gsum yod dgos 'dug pa dpyad pa mdzod /('der gzigs pa por zhu byar byang rigs su thag ma'i dpon rigs ga dus gang 'dra byung ba dang / de tsho'i lo tshig go thob sog4 lung 'dren yig rnyeng nga tshos ma rnyed stabs sus zer kha rjes 'brang nas lcaḍa kyus 'khridapa lta bu zer srol rjes 'ded gtso bor bya dgos byung bas 'di skor don 'dzol rigs mi yong dka' ba'i gnas la brten rgyang gzigs 'khul che'i blo mthun rnam pas bden dpang gi lo rgyus rgyu cha cung tsam dza gnang re'i 'dun pa zhu rgyu ni lo rgyus 'a bri mtshams 'dir bar bcub/ gi re ba yin/)lja pa/ byang rigs kyi dpyang sde dang so srung char can dam ga rtsis bcas kye skor/(1) dmag gi rtsa 'dzugs sdo na dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i lo 'go ste bod rab byung 13pa'i chu lug 1703lo nas sog po lha bzangakhang gis bod sa gnas kyi srid 'ji na lo 15(sbre lapo lo shas byas pa tshud )bzung yod pa'i dus rim nang khong ngo mas rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i gzhung sog lho byang khul sogs nas yuladamag rta dmab/ 300skor bsdu sbyong byas yod cing / lo ltar so gtong dang / dasku ga rtsis len gyi yod 'dug dmag gi 'go byed ni gong 'khod nang so zar ba de yin pa dang / 'di dus nang so'i dmag sgar gnasayul ni rgya mo'i nang la 46

yin 'dug (da lta nag chu khongs sa dkar shang )lo ltar dbyar dus su dmag sbyong rtsal 'gran rtsis len byed kyi yod 'dug pas/ nag chu'i char can dmag rtsis zer ba de dus 'di tsam nas 'go tshugs yod par mngon/ ma gzhi char can zer ba ni dbyar dus mtshon pa'i mngon rjod kyi ming yin pa sa dbyar kha'i dmag rtsis zer ba zhig 'dug rung phyis mi tshos lo lngar krig car gyi dus chen lta bur char can zhes pa'i go ba len gyi 'dug yul ngamag de dang thog sde pa sangs rgyam pa'i bod dmag yin nam snyam/ gang ltar jun gar can la dmag 'thab byed myong ba'i shodasro la 'dug jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyi dmag las lung sgyur gyed ring 'badzi/ ram dar ma dbang phywag gi gdan sa chen po gsang gzhung gi 'bam raca dgon pa gtor ba dang / bar tha'i dkar dgon nag kyog dgon pa gtor ba sogs byas pa'i shod rgyun yod pa red/ rab byung 12pa'i lcags byi 1910lo gong ma bde skyid rgyal po'i lung gis mngags pa'i dngu/nga dmag gtos che ba bod 'byor gyisajun gar mi bsun pa tshar bcad pa'i dus rim nang de yang dang thog mngags pa'i byang lam dpung dmag la jun gar pas nag chu 'di rgyud nas mkhregs rgol rgyag bcas byas rkyen ching dmag ha cang mang po 'ig rkyen lam du gyur pa lo rgyus las gsal bas deng 'di khul sa cha mang por phung po sbas shul byung ba 'ga' zhig 'di dag yin par snyam/ 'on kyang 'di dus lha bzang khang gis rtsa 'dzugs bzos pa'i char can dmag dang / nang so'i skor la ji byas gang byung sngar gtam gtan nas thos rgyu mi 'dug gal te thos rgya 47

che ba'i blo mthun 'gas 'di skor bag la zha ba'i lo rgyus 'dra gsung rgyu mchis tshe snying thag pa nas dga' bsu zhu 'os/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags phag 1911lor ching rgyal rabs 'thor ba nas bod kyi gong rim kha bral pas go skabs shig tu rtsis nas bod bzhugs blon chen lan an ban phyir 'bud dang / shon thong khri lo dang po'i skabs su btang ba'i bod skyod khron dmag ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar gyur stabs der (lu'u cun zer )rgol 'dzing 'khrug slong gis phyir 'bud byas pa'i lo rgyus bya rim byung yod pa'i nang sa srid nas nag chu'i byang rigs dmag mi lnga brgya bsdus te lha sa'i srib rgyud grib nas lu'u can dmag la rgol bcug par glaḍa ma rnyed pas a 6‘pho srib skyel zer ba'i ming 'dog byung tshul gleng rgyu yod pa ma zad dmag dpon mkhan po skar rdor nyi mas dmag dar shor bas khrims chad phog yod ska da/ lu'u cun dmag dpung mthar pham dmag dang bros dmag cig chags nas rgya nag nang sar 'then bros byed skabs tsho khul nas srung bzhin thar thabs byas rabs yid skyo ba'i rang bzhin can dang byang khul nas 'go pa kha shas kyis bros dmag 'ded bcom thub re byas rkyen mi bsad rgyu shor gyi nar brlab/ byung ba'i gnas tshulaskyi g.ya' ba bcas kyi lo rgyus shod rgyu yod cing / rab byung bco lnga pa'i me 'brug1915lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khams byang phyoḍa kyi khul du chab srid dgos mkho'i sgrig bzo lta bu ste me 'brug zhib gzhung zer ba byung rjes nag chu byang rigs 'dir rta dmag lnga brgya gtan 'khel gyis snga srol 'char can dmag rtsis de yang mkhan nang zhes pa'i nag chu rdzong 48

gi thad ku'i bkod 'doms 'og nag chu'i lte ba'i o rgod grong gi gser rnyed rgyud thang du me yos lo yan chad lo gnangs chag tu tshugs rgyu yod pas na/ de tshun char can thang zer gyi yod 'dug (deng nag chu'i sna 'dzoms tshong khang rgyud du yin/) 'di dus bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis byang rigs dmag deb chen mo zer ba zhig bzos 'dug1930lo lcags rta zhib dpyod kyi rjes nas slar yang byang rigs dmag kong 'phar bar brten dmag rkang re nas rta dmag gnyis re thon dgos pas khyon gzhung sger khongs dmag rkang 400lhag nas dmag mi 810lag thel brgyab nas nam dgos thon chog dgos pa dang char can dus dmag bsher rtsis len dgos pa bcas kyi lam srol bcings 'grol ma btang bar rgyun 'jab/sa kyis lag bstar byas pa red/ rab byung bcu drug lcags stag 1950lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' blon ra kha shag phun tshogs rab rgyas nag chur zhi drag spyi khyab tu 'byor nas byang rigs rta dmag 815yang bskyar sgrig skyor gyis bar tha'i jing gir dbang 'dus phun tshogs la mda' dpon dang lho byang brgya dpon gnyis dang / a mdo'i dpon rigs gur gung 'bum tshe blo bzang bcas la ru dpon a mdo'i dmag dpon mgar ba'i dbang rnam gyis gtsos de drag mi 8la brgyadapon sogs kyi go ming sprad nas dmag dpon la gzengs bstod pa dang me mda' dbyin ji kha ring 300sprad de zla shas ring dmag phogs kyang bod dmag spyi mtshungs ltar sprad yod pa red/ byang rigs kyi dmag dpung de bzhin sa gnas srid gzhung gi ka mad sgrig stangs kyi ang rtags 49

lta ra byas na tsa da nga — mag sgar red zer gyi 'dug de yang kha shas kyis byang rtswa thang gi dmag mi red zer mkhan yang 'dug bod sa gnas srid gnyung gis sngar na ma grags pa'i nag chu'i yuladamag sngar yod rtsa 'dzugasader drag chas spras te mthong chen de 'dra byed pa de bu rgyud kyi mtshon rtse yam̐ mar gtad pa dang 'dra ba'i bya spyod spel slad yin 'dug mi dam ngas bcings 'grol daca4ga rtse/sa chab mdor bcengs 'grol btang twes nag chu'i bka' shag 'ja' ltar yal nas mde mkhar bka' bla ra 'dam rting drung nas byang 'grim sa kyes gcang la lob/ ba dang / tsa da nga dmag brkya da brgya zer ba de'ang snga sa nas byi'u che 'apar ba ltar gyur dzo4 red/yang byang rigs dmagal ga6 /ca4 ru dang / bayen ru gnyis yod ‘/'i gapa/sa ru ni dmag gi sngo na 'gro yin zer bye/ yod pas me pha 1947lor rgyal zur rwa sgreng juca/ hes kyi ska bas su byang pye'i ba— 2 don bzhen byang dmagalho ma g.yas ru da nga / bar tha'i na mag /ba ga gci ga rwa rme nga dngo/na par pyin pa dang de chesu kyang de ga ra bod dmag gi pyed sta ngas / mig dper bzung nas mi ser la brdab gsig dang bcom 'phrog ci regaca5 byas pa'i gnas tshul gleng rgyun 'dug de rjes gser rdung chos skya bas khramaskopar gtor ba'i nang bod dmag gi rgyab sno na g.yas ru'i dmag khag gcig byin yod pa bcas sngar nas da bar dmag ni srid kyis kha lo bsgyur rgya yod pas dus skabs mi 'dra ba'i nang gi srid 'dzin 'go pa'i bzhed don ltar dmag gi 'gul skyod kyang de bstun yong gi yod pa byang rigs char can dmag gi lo rgyus la bltas na gsal po 'dug byang spyi lha'u50

rta ra'i skabs stod phyogs su byang rigs kye mi rtsa sde rigs yod tshad phyir 'gug byed mkhan bod dmag lding dpon zhig gis 'go pyed bar tha'i jing tshab dang / lho byang brgya dpon gyi tshab/ a mdo'i dpon tshab dmag dpon mgar ba dbang rnam bcas kyis 'go byas byang rigs dmag mi rta dam ga drug cu skor zhig btang ba lam bar nas khong tsho nang 'dzi/ la byung ba dang / dbang rnam nas sgar bzhag sa bzhag byas te la rgyab sga ra dpon bkyib/ nar khrid pa dang / mngar res su bca' sdod mda' dpon rngo mo 'u nga par pho shed tshad pa bcas kyi lo rgyus shod rgyu yod pa red/(1) so 4 ri nga gi skor/ sngar lha bzang pa'i dus jun gar la ca dgra dogs kyis 'i nga so btsugs rjes kyi dus mun gang 'tshams phyin pa'i mjug sa srid kyi bzhed don ba'in nag rdzong nang so lcang ra ba'i dus su cho)rdo /sne/ /rwa(1 shā)she //// 1rdordo 1)sdi )/// ////byang gas dmag ngas nas skya bdun na lnga sa ra bzhibyang so ring thung gsum la 'gro dgos pa byung 'dug skabs de'i ring so 'gro sa lung chung skyid po dang / 'bring so 'gro sa rdo rag sha/ thung so 'gros rtis ra gad dmar bcas yin yang so sa drug zer ba zhig kyang yod/byang rigs ru re'i sde tshan re byas te skya mi go lag rang 'grigs rta pa rer gro khal gnyisare dang bcas zla 4re'i mtshams 'khor res byas te grab dgos pa yin/ de rjes byang spyi lha'u rta ra'i yas mas shig tu zi bod gnyis ching 'grig byung bas byang so mi dgos zer nolo 'ga' bsdadapa dang / byang spyi ra sa rgya rgan skabs byang sor sngar bas dam don byas te 'go par spyir btang gi mi btang bas ma 'thus par byang rigs tsho 51

r+sha/ga /zakhor res su babs kyi de'i 'go dpon sto nga brgya ngo ma de rang 'gro dgos brjod pa red/ lo dang por bar thar babs pa'i jing tshab ru chen 'go pa rma phug g.yu rgod song ba dang / de'i lo rjes ma lcags stag 1ḍā50lor che 'bum dpon skar ma mthar phyin ngo bskyod song bar byang spyi dgyes tshor chen po byung skad/ 'on kyang stabs ma legs par so sa nas ha sa khe rigs kyi bros 'khyam pa thug nas dpon g.yog 15yod pa nas skad nganashod mi mi gcig lus yod pa ma gtogs tshang ma sdeb bsad shor ba'i do na rkyen byung ba red/ des h+ye/ cha/ byang rigs dar/ga gi byang so zer ba de (5daskyo ba'i ngang mjug sgril ba red/(3) char can dmag rtse sa/ char can dam 4 / rtse sa de lo bcag mar yo da/ 'di thog/ ma ra dam5/ rtsal rgyug len byed pa 'is/ nas khri mas kyi gzi rngam ston nga /'i chabasred kyi 'i ma rwa lta bu'i rnam pa sno na mkhan byung ba dang / de nas ོ nga rta rgyugs dang / zhar 'ben shed rtsal sogs pho rtsa la sna dgu 'gran pa'i do rwa zhig snon ma byung / des kyang ma cha da mi 'du rta tshogs kye tshong 'dus dang / glu bro mtshar rtsed sogs byed pa'i dga' ston dus chen lta bu zhig snon nas srol rgyun gyi dus chen zhig rim bzhin chags yod pa red/ byang rigs char can de lo bcag ma'i dbyar dkyil bod zla 7nang skor la byang rigs stong brgya dang las dmag brgyad brgya tshang 'dzoms kying ga yas g.yon gung gsum dang gsham mthud bcas kyi dmag sgar char can dmag deb ltar sgrig pa yin 'dug 'dirasngo na dkyil sgar nang du bar tha'i jing gir dang sku srung 'bu dar ba'i 52

dmag gur rgyag srol yod na yang / bar skabs nas dkyil sgar byang spyi mkhan rim sku srung bcas kyi dmag gur rgyagagi yod 'dug sngon gyi srol byas na/ g.yas ru nang so ru bas sne khrid lho ma shog drug dang / g.yonaru dang po brgya dpon ru bas sne khrid byang ma shog drug yin pa/ bar tha dang / gsang gzhung g.yas ru'i gsham mthud dang / a mdo dang /— hor smad g.yon ru'i gsham mthud sger chos khag ni ru gnyis kyi gsham mthud yin 'dug rtsal 'bul skabs dang thog g.yas ru nang so mi dkar rta dkar sdo na du rgyu9 pa ni sngon mes po sog dmag mcho na yas yin skad 'dug yang bar skabs nas sgar sgrig sogs sdon ma ji bzhin min pa—sna tshogs byed kyi yod 'dug 'dir bgrang bya brgyad cu brgal ba'i srid gros u yon bgres song blo gros (sngon gsang gzhung spyi khyab )nas bshad pa ji bzhin dum zhig bris par 'char can de dang po dmag mi 'dzom4brda btang ba dang / rgyas 'dzomaca/ byung ba da gar dang thog sa char thig tshad blangs nas dmag mi rer sa cha gom re sprod pa rdzogs mtshams tsho shog de ga'i dmag gur rgyag sa shing byang 'dzugs kyi yod rung g.yas g.yon sgor mo byas te sgrig pa'i lho ru dang po gsang gzhung dang gnyis pa bar tha byas pa dang / byang ngos nas dang po gzhung sog lho byang /gnyis pa a mdo sgrig ru sgor mo byas pa'i sne gnyis thug dgos pa dang / bar mtshams che chung ma rgyug par ru nang du lug gcig 'gro sa mi 'jug dang po nye skor du shog so sos gong khag nang skyong byed de'i phyi nyin gur rgyag mkhan sngon du yong nas gur phub tshar ba'i nyi ma dro 53

spyi khyab mi dkar rta dkar can zhig byas te sdon la rgyuḍa dgos/ de nas 'a ba brgya dpon gyis 'go khrid nas rgyu9 dgos pa yin/ gsang gzhung gi 'ar 'phen rta dmag rdzogs pa dang rjong mdunadu rta babs nas gus lugs zhwa phud zhus rjes rdzong mkhan nang nas mi rer kha btags re bkon pa dang / slar rta bzhin lha rgyal gtong ba'i/na log (rnag res rgyung thengs gsum re byed dgos )phyi nyin yob 'gyu ra dang / de nas me ma da' tsha kha lta ba songs byed/ byang spyi'i skabs su byang rigs nas rta 180skor bdam sa/ses/ kyisargyug ma 'granasdur byed kyi yo da pa dang / ang grangs tshanachen ngo spro da kyi yod pa ngad/ 'di dus phyi ru tshong pa /bag dang /ltad mo ba'e gur mang po bcas yod la dkyil sgar mdun mkhan nang gi khrims shing yang btsugs/ yod pa red/ yang bgres song kha shas kyes/sngon 'char can zhig gi dus shed rtsal 'gran gyi yod pa dang / a mdo'isog ru rig 'dzin gyis rlag pags kyi phyi la 'phyi ba'i mtshil byug nas shed g.yug pas/ slad grags bzhag pa red/ mi de'i shugs ni gyad mi lta bu las sus kyang 'gran mi thub zer sro/la 'dug byang rigs 'char can thog rgyug ma skad grags can gyi byang rta byang ma'i brgya dpon tshang gi yab this zer ba dang / bar tha'i dmar ru la zad zer ba de tsho snga rting gis rdzong dang / byang spyis dmigs rin tsam sprad nas rwa sgrong srid skyong la rgyud 'bul byas pa red/ gzhan yang chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod 'khrugacha chen po yang de dus yong gi yod pa/ dper na/ se dor dbang 'phel gyis rdzong la ngo rgol byas pa'i don rkyen (rab tsam gsham du gsal )sogs byung55

/mayang de dang mtshungs/ btsan po yar 'gro rnams/ nag chu nas ru ba'e gsang sa tshigs bar bskyel dgos pa dang / de nas gsang gzhung gis phomado bar bskyel dgos/ mar 'gro gsang gzhung gis gsang sa tshigs khanas nag chu bar dang de nas ru bzhis gad dmar bar bskyel dgos/nag chur btsan po che chung mang nyung tshang mar ru bzhis gtso byas gra sgrig dgos pa dang / gsang sa tshigs khar gsang gzhung gis gra sgrig dgos pa dang / 'om rkyang gsum mdor hor smad pas gra sgrig dgos pa yin nam rgyun sa srid kyi a drung sogs gsang gzhung bong ra dang nag chu 'om rkyang —bcas su rta zam chad med sgug dgos thog da dung zhe drag dpon rigs che 4'bringayar mar 'grul zhud lam rgyud gra sgrig sdod tshuḍa sam khra chen ni 'du nag dngan grang mo/ me rdo shar bar chu dkar thang ba cog gam mchigaru/ 'om rkyang sogs la gra sgrig dgos/ gra sgrig 'babs tshuḍa sam/ khra chen tshuḍa mal der spra gur da3tar nag thab bcas me shing sgrig dgos khar gos kha bla bre gdan lcog phying dmar sogs dpon regs rim pa'i thob thang bzhin le shor med pa ang bsar las mi ched bskos kyis sgrigs dgos pa yin/ nag chu'i sa tshuḍa su shog so so'i dmag rkang la gzhigs nas nyin grangs mang nyung gi sgu ga res gtan sdod byed dgos/ 'dir shog kha gcig dpe drangs nas bshad na bar tha sde gsar shog la mtshon na nag chur nyin bcu bzhi sa tshuḍa bzung dgos der mi brgya skor dang khal nyis brgya skor/ rtadrug cu skor dgos pa yin/ mi brgya po'i nang nas rgan po dang / gnyer g.yog ma byan bcas nang skos byed kyi yod pa dang / 'dis nag chur 67

katsan po babs ripos la sgrig sgo da nga / yar mar 'ul skyel byed dgos shing rta khal de gas ma 'dang na slar 'ded kyis yar 'gro gsang sa tshigs dang / mar 'gro 'om rkyang bar skyel dgos/ nag chu nas phyogs gzhan snyan rong rdzong dang phying lung rdzong lha ri rdzong sogs la gtong dgos rigs kyi a drung la rta 'ul gtong dgos pa dang / nag chu rdzong khongs su lan brda skyel dgos rigs la 'ang 'gro dgos pa/ gtan sdod byang spyiganyica/ sam rdzong gnyis/ ja sho sku srung dmag sogs kyi chu len thab g.yog sogs tha na sna tha gru ba bcas kyi las ka byed dgos pa ma zad/ go rogadang rgya mo'i nang bcas su rdzong gi rta drel rtswa ba/sos byed pa rnams kyi 'tsho g.yog rgyugs rgyu dang / rdzong nang la nyar ba'i chibs rta drel hrag bsdus la gso tshags byed rgyu/ de bzhin mar khang srung rgyu dang / btson khang phyi ra thun srung sdod rgyu/ khrims gcod skabs mgo rkang 'dzin rgyu bcas byed dgosapa dang / da dung lo khral om thig ces pa de sgril bzo byed dgos pa ma zad rdzong ngo las kyi dgos mkhor shing lcags bzo ba'am tshem bu rgyag rgyu sogs kyi las ka yang byed dgos la dbyar dus skabs skabs su mkhar lasakyang byed dgos/ rgyu 'gro'i thad nas nyin rer byang spyi'am rdzong ngo las mi rer mar nyag dgu re dang / lci ba sgye dgu re/ gnyer phyag yan las bya'i sdod khang la dgong ltar bzhu mar ze/ btson lto ja mar zhes ja bag chung gcig dang / mar grod gcig btson pa mi rer rtsam bre gang ri dang / btson khang du bzhu mar gcig (rgyun ldan bcan pa 15skor yod )btson srung gnyis la dngul (grangs ma nges )gang 'tshams re bcas dang 68

byang spyi'i skabs sku srung daca/ga 0/ dung pa bcas la'ang bzhu mar dang /dngulasprod dgos pa bcas lta bu red/ byang rigs ru bzhi'i tsho shog so sos de ltar res skor ba'i thog zla bzhi dang nyin nyi shu songe mtshams sgar yang res bskor 'khel gyi yod pa red/ gong gsal byang rigs kyis nag chur sdod sgrigs khral 'ul thad dper drangs pa'i shog kha 'dis gzhan ma rnams kyang mtshon nus pas skyar bshad ma byas/ yang dpe gcigadrangs na sngon bka' blon rag kha shag nag chur 'byor skabs lho ma shog drug gi nang gses me mdel ru ba dmag rkang drug yin stabs nag chur sa tshugs nyin 4 gsum sgrig dgos pa dang / skabs 'khel bas dud tshang re'i mi gnyis re phyin yang ma 'dang bar da dung ser trug grong pa'i nang nas mi bdun cu skor gla dgos pa byung yod/ de min skyel 'dren 'u lag thad byang rigs nang khul gcig gyur yin pa/ dper na sngon bar tha jing gir gyis byang rigs ru drug rdzong rtsis rgyag dus 'gro song blug rgyu mang che 'dod zhus byas te byung ba'i lo lta ra 'bri chu gser kha yar 'gro'i dus khal 100lhag dang / rta brgyad dgu zhig bar tha gzhung tsho lnga rang nas snying drung sbas tshang sa tshigs bar skyel dgos pa lta bu red/ dmag sgar babs dus sgrig cha byas zin pa'i thog da dung sgrig dod zer ba dang / rta khal stong gla zer ba'ang phon chen sprod dgos pa bcas yin/ dbul po mi treng gcig yin rung rkang khral rgyug dgos pa ma zad/ kha rgyun du rgyu yod rgyu khral/ rgyu med rkang khral/ nus med rgyal po lo khral zer gyi yod pas 'tshonus gtan nas med pa'i mi da lta rgyal khab kyi 'gan srung lnga byed sa'i kha 6 9

gtad 'di pes lta bu'i mi / kyang (rnadi dus nus med lo khral lo rer dngul srang do zho gsum gyi khral 'jal dgos/ de bas kyang bar tha'i shog kha kha shas su mi hreng gcig gis rkang khral rgyugs pa'i thog la nor mas gcig gi rgyukhral stong 'jal byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ 2dir blo mthun 'ga' res khog stod tshon ngo 'i mtshil mi 'khya nga/ khog smad rgyud rus rkang mi bro 7 zer ba'i dpe de ma gzhe spyi nyi nga spya la sbyod chob/ pa yin rung lhag par byang riḍa bar tha tsho par mngon che tsam rmad/ gong gsal nus med rgyu med kyi mi la rgyukhral 'khri mkhan mang po yod pa dag ni khog smad rgyu rus rkang mi bro ba zhig yin pa dang / brgya dpon dang mi drag 'byor phyug hrag po khag gcig yod pa dang / lhag par gung pa tshang nor nyis stong skor dang / lug dgu stong skor rta 150skor sogs phye zog yod khar nang dngos de dang mtshungs pa yod pas na bar tha sger gzhung smos ci/ byang rigs khul yongs nas phyugashos yin pas khog stod tshon po'i mtshil mi 'khyag pa yod pa red/brgyad ba byang rigs kyi 'go pa'i za sgo dang khral chag/yulasrol ) khrims tsag tsig sogs kyi skor/ bod sa gam/sa srid gzhung she4byang riḍa khul du sa/zhung sger chos zhes pa'i nang ge sger pa lta bu la brtsis nas dmag rkang gi dmag khral 'khri ba/ snyer btsan sa bkag dang /g.yog bkol 'dab dud yod pa'i dpon rigs ni bar ba'i jing gir dang gsang gzhung 'a ba'i spyi khyab tshang / bar tha'i jing gir bgos nga sba chena.a/ rgod tshang bcas nyung shas las yod pa ma yin/ rjes/ ma'i jing gir 70

dbang 'dus ru na tshogs ma/sa sger sa mi ser la za ru 'jug ba 0 sa che btsan dpon khag gzhan ma'i las zlos de tsam byed kyi med pa red/gzhung sog lho byang gi brgya dpon gnyis la dmag rkang gcig re'i khral chag dang lo ltar sde thog nas mar khal bco lnga'i za sgo yod pa dang / phyi 'gro'i gro rtsis sde thog la sgrug pa yin/ bod zhe ba'i bcings 'grol zin rjes 55lo nag chur spyi khyab don gcod las khungs tshugs nas byang rigs dpon khag mang tsam las khungs so sor 'os 'tshams kyi 'go khrid du bkod sgrig byung nas phogs dngul yang len rgyu byung ba'i dus skabs de'i nang mang ches da dung ‘ za khag gnyis 7byas nas sngar gyi za sgo sde thog nasalen rkyang byed kyi yod pa dang / byang ma'i brgya dpon a gong nor dar gtsos nyung shas nas za sgo nyis brtseḍa byed mi 'os par sems nas de nas bzung gzhung gis sprad pa'i phogs dngul len pa las shog kha'i nang gi za sgodang phyi 'gro'i rtsis yongs rdzogs ma zas pa red/ shog kha so so'i 'go pa rdaro khar rta mgo re'i khral chag yod pa dang / sger pa'i 'go pa tshor thems tshar re za rgyu yod/ de bzhin shog so so'i rgan po tsho la grangayotshad nges can gyi khral chag phran tsam byed kyi yod/ hor smad kyi dpon 'go tshor sger sa che tsam bdag 'dzin byed kyi yod 'dug a mdo shog brgyad kyi dpon khag tshor 'gram 38re'i khral chag yod pa dang dmag dpon dang rgan po la 'gram brgyad re'i khral chag yod/ a mdor dpon 'gan khur myong ba'i dpon zur zhig yin pyin rgyu nor ji ltar yod rung 'gram bzhi khral las 'jal mi dgos pa yin/ a mdo tho gar tshang zer ba'i phyug po de sngar 71 —— — /de——

ོ/ nga sa lnga pa checha po dang / ku thi han skabs kyi bka' gtan yod pas khral 'jal mi dgos pa' sger btsan yin/ de bzhin byang rigs khuladubatsan dmigs kyi bka' gtan yod mkhan nam/ bka' gtan dngos gsal med rung 'go 'dren dang / nye rgyab gzhan skyor bcas yod ba'i 'brog dud ya zung khral mi dgos pa'am nyung ngu las 'jal mi dgos pa'i gnas tshul yang yod/ lcags rta zhib gzhung nang 'khod gra zog la khral med cing / dgon sde dang / grub mthab gang yin la ma ltos pa'i grwa btsun sger gyi phyug zog gang yod khral mi 'khri ba dang / grwa pa khyim dang 'dod gcig la khyim de'i bzhi zur gcig khral mi dgos pa bcas yin/na ga chur gtan sdod byang rigs ru shog so so'i ru mi re yod pa de'i za sgoni lo rer 'bru khal 34dang mar khal 18tshar ru 50 tshar g.yog dod dngul srang 50lci ba sgye 50lug lpag 5bcas red/ byang rigs 'go pa'i las don ched du nang khul nag chu dang / phyir lha sa sogs sa gnas ring thung gar song gar bsdad kyi 'gro song mtha' dag so so'i tsho shog nas 'gagakhur dgos pa red/ 'dir 'go pa /ba shas kyis mun nag sbar btsum gyi dpe bzhin phyogs 'gror mi gcig la g.yog po kha shas kyi 'gro song blug pa dang / yang kha shas nas sde la snyad nas don med 'gor 'gyangs dang /se hrug grong pa'i nang chung ma zur bsten gyes chang rag bag gsum gyi 'khoralo bskor nas yun ring sdod kyi yod pa red/ nyung shas kyis sde thog nas 'gro song che za byed pa de phyi ma'i lan chags kyi khur rdo zhig tu brtsi yi yod pa red/ de min dos skyel 'dren sogs phyogs 'gro'i regs byed 72

mkhan dmangs ma mi grangs du song gi gro rtsis kyang so so'i tsho shog nas 'gan khur dgos (khral rtsis kyi gro bsdu'i tshad gzhi ni zla gro rer lug shakhog 1ja bag 1 mar nyag 10 skya zas zer ba rtsam phyur bre 10bcayoyin )rkun shor jag 'ded kyi rtsad gcod dang / sde thog gi gyod kha mchubyung regs kyi 'gro song yang sde nas sgrub dgos/ de min dpon rigs dang ru mi gsar bsko skabs ru mi dang / brgya dpon nas rdzong la gsar mjal kha btags dang / sha thud mar gsum nges can zhig 'bul dgos pa dang / 'go pa rda ro bas brgya dpon la gsar mjal zhu skabs gong bzhin 'bul dgos/ lo ltar lo gsar skabs shog re nas rdzong gnyis la lo mjalalug sha mgo 'byar re dang / phyur rlon pags rdag zer ba bzhi re 'bul dgos/ gong gsal gyi nang khral lam 'gro sgo'i khral rigs rnams lo 'khor skabs shog so so'i dmag rkang la gzhigs te ru drug gcig gyur gyis rdzong rtsis dang de nas ru bzhi'i ru rtsis byas te chad lhag kha 'thab byed kyi yod pa red/ byang rigs kyi phyi'am nang khul gyi tsho shog phan tshun mi ser brje 'grul spo skyod byed skabs dpon khungs so so nas 'khrol 'dzin thob dgos pa dang / de'ang 'khril 'dzin zhu bar bcad grangs ma nges pa'i nor lug gam dngos dngul gang 'tshams re dpon der sprod dgos pa yin/ khyim dud nang kha ma shis nas bgos rgyag pa'iskabs dpon la bgos phud zer ba nor dang dngos po sprod dgos pa yin rung tsho shog so sor grangs tshad gcig gyur med/ nang bgos skabs khyim gcig la mi thog gsum bzhi zin pa'i rgan khog yod na rgan 73

mtshan 7zhes der mi mgo bgos kyi skal thob gzhan las lhag pa sprod srol yod pa dang / mag pa'am mna' ma blangs nas lo gsum ma zin na pha ma'i gces zog las grong pa'i bgos skal sprod srol med pa bcas yin/byi phrug ste ne tshe sbyar bar zhu gtug byed mkhan byung na spyir btang ma 'bri ra gsum sprod dgos zer srol yod rung / don dngos do bdag phanatshun gyi 'jon nus la gzhigs nas 'bri gcig skor tsam las mang po sprod kyi med pa red/ byang rigs stong brgya tsho'i nang khul tsho shog gi gyod don tsag rtsig thag gcod byed cing / nyes dngul dang sgrig rtags len pa'i khar skabs re khrims gcod chung ngu'ang gtong ba yin/ rgyad kha mchu'i nang sgrig 'os 'dom ra yod pa'i rigs byang spyi'am rdzong sa nas slong 'bebs zhus te kha mchu gtam srol yod/ mi bsad me shor sogs chag sgo che ba'i rigs rdzong la zhu dgos pa las bsub mi chog nam zhug rgyun du 4phu la ri klung rngon rgya dang / mda' la yul grong rkun rgya 7zhes pa'i khrims srol yod pa dang / lhag par tā la'i dgung keg skabs sogs kyi dus su ched dmigs rtsa tshig 'grems kyi yod la byang spyi'am rdzong mkhan nang nas kyang de'i mjug gnon gyis gan thel len gyi yod/ khrims gtam nang / gong phud gsum yod pa ste spyang ki sdeg pa'i sa bon yin pas gong la phud/ rku ma bstan pa'i spyi dgra yin pas gong du phud/ byi ba gnod pa'i gzhi ma yin pas gong du phud 7zer gyi yod pa dang / de min ri klung skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags che phra mi 'jigs srog giskyabs sbyin dgos tshul shod kyi yod/ bya yi sgo nga phon chen bzhag sa'i 74

lho ma shog gi hang mtsho zer ba de shog khas lo ltar bya sgong bzhag nas bzang sgong rgya ra / ral bar mi 1res srung nas sdod dgos pa yin/ 'di riri su lagayang rngon rgya srung ba'i bya ba yin stabs khral thog la blug gi yod/ 'on byang lo ltar rdzong mkhan nang gnyis la bya sgong chig stong skor re'i khral 'bul dgos pa der rngon rgya ched gtor byas par brtsi srol mi 'dugadagu ba/ byang rigs khul gyi tshong las sbyi dang bye brag 'bam tshong dang ha dam bun skyed sogs kyi skor/(1)tshong las spyir btang sngon nas nag chu or rgod grong de bod byang phyogs kyi tshong 'dus grong zhig yin pa 'dir tshong khag che 'bring chung gsum gtan sdod byed mkhan mang la rgya dkar nag gi tshong zog dang / yul thon bshas bal mar gsum dang / zhor thon tshwa bul bcas yod la/ zi ling ba'i zing rta zing dril sogs mkho rgu'i dngos zog mang po yod/ lhag par sger tshong khag ni/ zhabs dgon sman sgrub skabs dang a mdo mtsho dmar sde tshogs skabs/ stag lung sgrub mchod/ 'dam spyi rim/ gtsang khang nag dus tshong bcas su mang po yong gi yod pa red/ 'dir stong brgya dpon rigs dang / mi rgyu gnyis 'dzoms kyi 'brog pa dum zhig tshong khag la 'brel 'dris dang / tshong las la dang 'dod byed kyi yod pa las 'brog dmangs spyi byings ni zog rtsa srog rtsa byas te lo ltar tshwa len tshong skor zhing 'brog brje tshong tsam la 'gro ba las tshong la dga' snang mi byed/ zhing 'brog brje tshong skabs tshong zong ni gtso bo mar dang bshas dkar nag yin 'kha.a mdo dang / bar tha rgyud kyis tshwa len mang tsam 'gro thub pas 75

tshong zog kyang tshwa bul khyer gyi yod/ tshong yul thad spyir btang bya4na hor smad ni lho kha zangs ri rgyud la 'gro mang ba dang / bar tha ni chu shur dang / gong dkar/ stod lung sogs la 'gro/ ma mdo lho ma rnams phan po dang / snye mo rgyud du 'gro/ de min gzhung sog sger gzhung dang / gsang gzhung bcas lo rer thengs gnyis re'ang 'gro ba tshong sa gtso bo phan po dang / snye mo/ stod lung / stag rtse sogs dang / gtsang phyogs pa snam mam/ rnam gling bcas yin/ zhing khul gyi sa gnas la spyir btang brje tshong gi thang gzhi ni mar 'degs khal rer/ 'bru kha ru do skor nas sum skor bar yod pa dang / bal sgor rer 'bru khal bzhi nas lnga/ lug rer 'bru khal do nas gsum bar/tshwa brje po la 'bur ma/ khal g.yag rer 'bru khal bcu drug nas nyer bzhibar bcas yin pa dang khu lu dang la phug brje po sogs byed/ de min hor smad dang / a mdo bcas kyi nang gi mi tshang 'ga' zhig gis lha ri ar rtsa dang / rgyas shog stod rgyud kyi dud tshang 'ga' zhig dang / tshwa shing brje po slog pa'am/ tshwa 'bru dus ra gtam nas brje tshong byed kyi yod 'dug lo ltar a mdo mtsho dmar sde tshogs dus gtsang phyogs kyi sku drag tshong pa 'u yug stag rtse bde gling ba dang / khang dmar ba bcas nas 'bru rgyab sum brgya lhag gis mar bal sgrub kyi yod par bal do rer 'bru khal gci ga re sprod pa dang / 'bru khal phyed gsum gyis mar khal gang re brje ba yin/ tshong pa tshos ja phrug ras sogs mar bal sgrub rgyu byas nas 'brog par mgo rdung rag gi yod rung 'brog pa yang thag ring du 'gro/ mi 76

dgos pa'i stabs bde yod pas blor mi 'bab pa de tsam med/ 'di dus 'brog mar de ltar sgrub rung da dung 'bel tsam yod pa dang / lha sa'i khrom la'ang nag chu'i 'brog mar brod 'thum de spus yag tshad du 'ardzog nas rin gong gzhan las cung che ba lon/ nag chur zi ling rta tshong 'byor skabs snga sa nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bka' don byang so khag nas rta bsher byas zin pas zing rta 'gros ma legs gras rnams rta dam rgyab nas lha sar gzhung dang che btsan khag nas bdam nyo byed kyi mod pa dang / lhag ma'i rta yag gras nas byang rigs stong rgya 'am tshong pa tshos sgrig nyo byed kyi yod pa red/(2)'bam tshong skor/ nag chu'i byang rigs tsho khag gi 'brog pa kher gtsang yin pas 'brog thon 'bel po yod pa smo sa ci dgos/ 'di ni 'brog pa dar rgyas su gtong ba'i cha — rkyen yin rung / spyi tshoḍa yul dus kyis rkyen pas skabs re 'brog sde rang nyid mi rabs nas mi rabs bar ha dam gyi rgya mtsho'i nang du nub dgos pa'i rkyen rtsa zhig tu 'gyur nas ri dwags gla ba'i rtsi thum gyi dpe zlar gyur gyi yod pa red/ 'brog thon g.yang mo lug gi rgyab bal ni phyir 'gro'i tshong zog 'gangs chen zhig yin cing / nag chu'i byang rigs tsho khul ni dngos po 'di dag yong khungs che gras shig yin par brten dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go nas rim bzhin bod kyi btsan phyug 'dzoms pa'i sger chos tshong bcas kyis hab thob rgyag shugs che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/ rwa sgreng rgyal thog skabs la nag chu rdzong mkhan nang nas rdzong khongs kyi bal gamadzub dkris tsam ma lus pa ra bla la tshong rgyu'i btsan gan blangs nas rin 77
