lo zhig la dpon a lhab zer bas 'tho/ byas mtsho nag shar sne nas ru bros kyis stod mnga' ris su lo shas bsdad nas phyir 'khor rjes dud grangs sngar las mang ba dang / rgyu nor gang tsam 'phel yod rung / bod sa gnas srid gzhung la khral rigs sgrub rgyug tshul mthun dang blang min par brten/skabs de'i nag 'go sbrel pos se dpon a lhab che da 'gugs kyis bka' nan phab par a lhab nas gyen rgol gyis mdun lcog steng khu mtshur gzhus tekhyed tsho'i kha la nyan mi thub brjod nas gri yu lag 'chang ngang sgor thon phyir log song ba dang de rjes rdzong gi mkhan pos bar tha dang / gsang gzhung a mdo bcas kyi dmag 'ga' zhig bskul nas se dor dpon gyi spra thog la babs pa dang dpon a lhab gar song med pas dpon tshang gi kha dbang rtsis len gyi dngos tho 'god bzhin pa'i sgang glo bur du rgyab kyi ri nas dpon a lhab phyu dkar zhig gyon/ rta dkar zhig khyer/ bod mda' gcig lag sbod bzung gcig ske la gon sbe len skor/ sbir thi sgron te/ ngar skad chen pos nga'i kha gtad dgra bo mkhan nang gnyis yin/ (rdzong dpon )rogs bar rul ma dang gsang rul ma (bar tha dang gsang gzhung )sram gzig gnyis kyi mi yin/ ngo shes kyi yod sgug ang a mdo shog kha brgyad rtsod pa med pas skya rug ger phar gyes shig zera'abod bzhin ri thur du rbab rdo sgril ba ltar byung bar brten tshang ma skrag nas bros pa dang mi kha shas kyis sems gnag byas te bros rtsis byed pa'i rdzong mkhan po chibs drel gyi phong la kha gtad nas bskyon pa dang / phyir bros byed skabs mkhan po'i sna ru kha sdis gser byas pa zhig yod pa de 81

dbyugs nas med/ rjes so ra a ca/do shog brgyad kyis bar 'du3 byas terdzong mkhan po dang / se dor a lhab gnyis mna' shag bsgrigs yod pa red/ mna' shag byas rjes dpon a lhab kyis rum nas sna ru'i kha sdis blangs te shag rgan mkhan po'i gser 'dir yod zer nas sprad yod pa red/('di dmangs khrod rgan rabs kyi kha rgyun las lo dus gang yin mi gsal )(3) se dor dbang 'phel gyis rdzong la gyen rgol byas pa chu rta lo'i gong tsam 1940lo'i skor nag rdzong mkhan po ra sgreng lde 'chang rgya bo'i dus byang rigs 'char can dmag rtsis skabs shig tu g.yon ru'i a mdo shog brgyad kyi khongs a mdo ga rgya'i me ser 'go 'thom pa zhig rta bzhon bzhin rdzong gi dbu gur nye 'gram dkyil sgar bshag nas phyin pas skabs der rdzong gi zhabs gras kha shas rgyuḍa nas mi de rta las phabs te rgyagardung 'then drud byed kyin bkyig nas rdzong gi gur sgo'i khrims shing thog la bsdam pa red/ tshang mas de mthong ba dang se dor dpon dbang 'phel gyisaki chen pos a mdo shog brgyad chas shog ces 'bod bzhin khrims shing gi rtsar rgyuḍa phyin pas a mdo'i mi mang po zhig mnyam du 'ur nas khrimasashing la bcings pa'i mi ser de blangs pa dang / khrims shing gris gtub byas khar dpon dbang 'phel gyis dkyil sgar gtor dgos bshad de tshang ma dkyil sgar du 'tshang nas dpon gyi ngag bkod ltar gos chen dang / 'bog tho gyon mkhan tshang ma la rgyob shig zer ba'i sgra gnam sa g.yo ba ltar grags nas rdzong dpon ngo las thog shor bas thub bstan bag gong zer ba sogs 82

mkhan nang gi zhabs gras mang po zhig la rdo theb nas ga sa gar khrag gis khengs pa dang zhwa mo 'bog tho gang sar dbyung/sa nas bros phyin pa ma zad/rdzong sku ngo rnams kyang maskra ga na lam bur bdam kha med zer ba'i dpe bzhin lham 'bog chu 'bog byas nas bros pa red zer rgyun 'dug gang mtshams nas zhabs dgon nam/ tshong rigs/ byang rigs stong brgya gzhan ma tshos bar pa dang / zhu ba byas te gzhi nas zing cha 'jags pa red/ gnad don chen po thon zin pas a mdo shog brgyad kyi dpon 'go de yod rnams 'dus te skyid sdug gcig pa byed dam kha kha so so byed nang gros byas pa'i gcig gyur bya rgyur kha 'cham yod pa red/ de rjes se dor dpon dbang 'phel a mdo mtsho dmar du yong nas stotsāma'i dpon spyi khyob skal dgram dang / dpon bsod nams rdo rjer zur 'phradanang gros byas par dpon dbang 'phel nas lha sar gzhung gtug 'gro rgyur bshad par am stod dpon ba sug bsod nams rdo rjer kha gtad sde pa gzhung la byas nas gzhung gtugs byed sa yang sde pa gzhung la byas na pham kha yong rgyu nyag gcig las med/ de bas nga tsho a mdo shog brgyad gnas skabs ring byang bye ri rag par rgyab rten bcol na drag de ltar byas na sgrub khang bla brang dang / tsha sprul bla brang sogs dang tshong khag che gras 'ga' zhig thon nas bar 'dum byed srid pas de dus babs lta byed chog jus mi lag ma shor gong bsam gzhig bya rgyu gal che zhes brjod par se dor dpon dbang 'phel nas gtam bden pas 'then/ dpa' yus kyis 'dzing zer ba'i dpe ltar ngar yus kyis gdong nas83

du la nag phyur bzhin brjod pa rnadi ltar rgya‘ra ba 3 na po che tu yul du ja chibs sgyur gnang skabs nga tsho a mdos zhabs zhu gang drag zhus pas gziḍa gsos khral rigs sgrub phyogs skor dmigs bsal rtsa tshig don tshan 13thon pa'i ngo bshus da lta bsdad mus la mkhan po khyi rgya bos (rdzong ra sgreng lde 'chang )rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' shog rdog rdzis btang ba'i gnad don de ngas thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser lcog ser po'i thog 'jog rgyu byung na nga rgas po 'dzin bzung ngam dmar gsod gang byung rung 'gyod pa med/ de dus a mdo shog brgyad gang 'dra byed min am dpon rnam pas gzigs zhes bshad pa red/ (gong gsal gtam gleng de dag blo mthun nor bsam phru gu'i dus dngos su mthong thos kyi rtso gnas tshul yin ) de nas dpon dbang 'phel rogs pa a mdo smad ma'i dpon ar skyabs dang / dbang 'phelagyi tsha bo bu tsheng bcas lha sa ra bcar bas dbang 'phel btson du tshud pa dang / de gar khong dang thug 'phrad byed mkhan la sde pa gzhung la khrims mi 'dug brjod bzhin ring min btson khang de rang du grongs pa red/ rting ma'i thag chod kyang mi tshang 'di pa'i mis se dor tsho pa'i dpon byed mi chog pa ma zad/ mi gsum gral 'gor sdodayi chog pa'i bka' yig thon nas se dor dpon gyilogyen rgol byas pa'i mjug 'bras de lta bu'i ngang mjug sgril rung / mi ser nas rjes ma'i dpon rgyud de rang bsko rgyu u tshugs mtha' bkag byas rkyen me rabs rjes mar dbang 'phel gyi tsha bo slar yang dpon du gyur yod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul byung yod/ 84

khongs dud cherngo / tshos rta sbod sku ra ba tsam las mi ngo thon pa nyu nga yang snying dpon kur mthar gyis gtsos rta pa nyer lnga/ gro khal rang 'grigs byang so lothon pa red/ so sa lte ba ba yan sna 'byed rgyud du byas/ so bskor ba yan la tshad gsum pa tshun du byas yod pa/ zla shas sdod ring gnas tshul gang yang ma thon par so dus thim nyer phyir log gi ba yan sna 'byed nas thon te 'dor ma'i ltag lung du sdod slabs ha sa jag pa'i bskor bcom 'khel nas mi gcig las ma lhag bar dpon g.yog tshang ma sdebs bsad kyis sgar chas rta sbod gro khal sogs tshang ma dgra la shor ba red/ so dmag jag nyes kyi gtam ngan shod mi gcig pu ni dpon gyi g.yog po lha g.yang chos 'phel zer ba yin/ kho yang lus la mda' rmas bcu gnyis byung yod rung srog gi dbang po ma 'gag tsam ro dkyil nas thon nas lam bar gcan spyang gi gnod 'tshe dang / chu chen gyi 'jigs pa/ltog skom gyi mnar gcod bcas myong bzhin par pha yul du 'khor ba red/mi tshos 'di ni de'i gong du byung ma rmyo nga ba'i byang rigs kyi dpon 'go dgra la shor ba'i don tshabs chen zhig la brtsi gi yod pa red/ che 'boms so dmag jag nyes phyin pa'i skad ngan shod mkhan lha g.yang chos 'phel de lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang bar 'tsho sdod byas yod/ rgan po'adi pas bshad pa'i so dmag dgra shor gyi gnas tshul gsham la tog tsam gleng na ( de snga kho rang ngo mas blo mthun mkhyen rtse sogs la bshad pa ) gong gsal che 'boms dpon kar mthar gyis so dpon byas pa'i byang rigs che 'boms tsho pa'i so dmag skya mi nyer lnga des so sa/ra phyin 87

na so 5 na skor rim par byas rjes phyer log gi lam ba yan sna 'byed zer ba brag phug yod sa zhig la nyin 'ga' shas shig bsdad nas ri dwags mar po bsad yod pa dang / shar nub rgyud la skya mi 'ag/'a zhig 1rdo shes 3) 4pha byemi bya'o dadza 3rdo / :sno ༷)sa ra 4sa rgyang sa da pya yad pa da 'a dus na ltar rkyang hrang nag gcig rgyu9 yo nga nas so pa'i rta khyu rnams lho phyogs su dkrog 'gro gi yod 'dug der kha shas kyis rkyang 'di 'dra zhi bdag ji/ rjes 'gebared zar ba dang / yang kha shas nas dgra ngo yin pas sngar gyi so sar 'di 'dra byung rabs la rkyang de bsagan legs sogs brjod nas rkyang de bsad pas de nas bzung rta dkrog mkhan ma byung ba red/ nyin zheganub la 'gro mkhan so pas me mda'i skad gnyis thos byung zer gyi yod pa dang / der nyin zon byas pas slar gang yang ma mthong / de nas nyin zhig sa cha de nas tshur sgar bkyag yongs bas yun ring 'gro long ma byung bar rtswa chu 'dzom sa zhig dang 'phrad pas der sngon chas so dmag nas sgar 'bab rtsis la dpon kur mthar gyis da lta 'dir bsdad na tshugs ma nye drags pas phar tsam phyin na zer bar gzhan ma tshos 'dir rtswa chu 'dzom pa'i sdod rgyu las byang sa la gang sar rtswa chu 'dzom pa mi rnyed pas tshugs thag nye ring blta rgyu ci yod bshad par de thog tu song nas sa der sgar babs pa dang / snga sa nas btang ba'i so pa kha shas yod pa yang phyir 'byor mthong thos gang yang med pas blo lhod ngang slar sgar rgyab kyi ri sgang du so pa mi gnyis btang / so sgar chen mos tsha ja dang po 'khol nas dpon g.yog tshang ma sa ja phor ba kha shas btung rjes slar chu snon brgyab pa'i 88

ja bar ma de'ang 'khol nas 'thung grab skabs glo bur du tshang mas de re de re zer kha gcig grags ngang mthong bar rta pa khra chags se zhig gis so sgar skor nas byung / ci bya med par tshang mas me mda' khyer nas mdun ngos su del chung zhig 'dug pa la kha gtad nas bzang po'i dkon chogazer bas sne khrid nas gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rgyugs pas bar skabs me zhig la mde'u thebs nas rke nas khrag thon bzhin sar 'gyelab dang / de 'phral de 'phros rnams 'gro mtshams chad nas nems nur ngang d+ngha 4dun phyogs der 'gro ma phod par chu shur zhig gi rgyud du hreng nas me mda' 'phen gyin bsdad/ dgra'i me mda' ni sran ma rngos pa ltar dang thog del chung thog gi mi ba rgyad por ga zer nas 'phang gi yod pas chu shur 'gram gyi mi rnams shi rmas gang yang ma byung ba dang so dmag gi gro khal dang / gro lucha/rams ni gar song 'dir song mthong rgyu med rung / rtasnams nye 'gram de ru hrugager langs nas bsdad yod pa red/ dpon yod sa'i so dmag tshos 'di nas bros rgyu'i go skabs red/ rta rnams bsdad yod pa ma zad/ 'di gar mi la da lta skyon chagam byung gong bros dgos zer bar dpon skar mthar nas rta bsdad yod rung / del ge'i thog mi yod pa 'di tsho skyur nas bros blos mi bzod— 'di mus mun rub thub na nga tsho thar yang srid de min shi na mnyam shi dang / gson na mnyam gson byed rgyu las kha shas 'thab bzhin ngang kha shas bros rgyu med ci yang gang bskos red/ nga'i mde'u rta sgro gang yod pa 'di del ge'i thog gi mi brgyad po la skyel bar khyed tsho su 'gro nus ces bshad pas 89

der yod nang nas nga 'gro khas len byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung ba red/de rjes gang mtshams nas del ge'i thog gi mi tsho'i nang nas mem skad 'jamadu 'gro gi yod pa dang / chu 'gram rgyud kyi mi tsho'i nang nas rag nor zerab zhig yod pa des phye nud byed kyin ngang rta 'gram du slebs nas kho rang la sger rta gnyis yod pa de gcig bzhon gcig 'khrid nas bros par brtsam pas/ 'khrid bya'i rta de 'gro rogs gtan nas ma byas pa'i mus/ gzhan ma tshos da res nas bros zer dus bros na yag tshod yin/ lto sa dang da ni srog mgo gang thon gyis ra thar lug thar bros kyi 'dug zer nas dpon la'akhang ra byas pas/ dpon nas skyon med dus 'di tsam la thug dus skad ngan shor mi gcig thar na 'ang rab yin zer ba dang sprags mi der skad chen pos kho re rta 'khrid rgyu skyur la mgyoḍa par bros zer 'bod kyi yod pa red/ mi des ni da dung rta gcig po skyur ma bra bar 'khrid e thub lta bzhin pa'i mtshams der dgra'i me mda' thebs nas bsad pa dang / de 3nas nyi ma dgong nye'i mtshams su slebs dus del 'bur gyi mi 8po'i mem skad med pa dgra yis tshang ma bsad tshar ba dang / me mda' gcig sdud kyis chu shur rgyud kyi mi la gtad nas rub pas der gab bzhin 'phen res gtug bzhin pa'i so dmag rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis khun pa tha rer lnga lam du gyur pa dang / dpon skar ma mthar phyin dpung par mes rmas byung ba/ khong gi g.yog po la'ang mem rmas byung zhing gzhan dag phal cher bsad tshar ba'i mtshams der ha sa jag pas ngar skad dam ngud mo 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra dang lhan cig phyogs mtshams kun nas rub 90

byung bar dpon nas da ni shi ran zer bzhin lag rten btsugs bzhin langs te thung mda' lag sbod bzung nas mdun phyogs su thon pa dang /skabs 'dir g.yog po rmas mar slar yang mda' thebs nas rmas skyon gyis ‘tshor ba shor bas ga byas ma tshor/ lha g.yang chos 'phel dbang po gsos skabasamun rub tshar zhing ha sa jag pa rnams sgar la rub nas ngar sgra dang ngu sgra 'dra ba'i sgras gnam sa khengs shing / sgar me brgyab nas me 'od gsal lhang nger yod pa dang / 'gram nas rmas ma zhig kha grags nas thon byung ba dgra lha zer ba de yin 'dug (naca/ rgyun mi tshos dgra lha spyon pa zer pho shed can gyi gral la 'jog )des skad ngan shod mi gcig pha yul du 'gro thub pa dgos pas/ khyod ni rmas mang thebs pas gnas skabs ma shi rung 'phral du 'gro thub pa dka'/ nga'i rmas skyon don snod la 'khelabs nam ma langs tsam la shi rgyu red/ da dung ro yi khrod nas/ rmas tshab chung ba zhig e thon lta dgos zer tog tsam bsdad mur yang mi gcig nud byung ba der brang rus zur gcig gtor nas de ga nas dbugs thon pa zhig byung 'dug dgra lhas khyod rang brang rus rmas pa las don rtsod la skyon mi 'dug pas mi 'chi nges/ nged rang gsum nas mas tshabs khyod yang ba 'dug pas gtam ngan shod mi pha yul la e slebs kyis/ sdug rus byas nas rta gcig lon thabs kyis khyod bskyon e thub lta zhes brjod par mi des nga skom nas thi rgyu red/ chu 'thung bar nud 'gro zer ba las nyan blo tsam yang ma byas par thur du rgur nas phyin/ de nas khos da kho ni 'gro blo mi 'dug pas khyod rang rmas mang rung rmas tshabs cung chung bas 91 —— — — /de/—

drag shas che/ nam langs nas sgar la song / phal cher dgra yis bod sbogasgum shing mer brgyab nas lcags hreng dbyugs bzhag yod kyi red/sgar shul nas bod sbod dang / rdzas dang sbi thi 'dra e rnyed ltos de 'dra rag na lam nas gcan gzan gyi dgra 'gog thub la chu chen brgal dus kyang phan zer/ de rjes gang mtshams nas ho sarag pas sgar chas bsdus/ rta khyu ded nas phyin tshar ba dang / nam ma gsal tsam dgra lha smyon pa yang shi/ nam langs rjes lha g.yang chos 'phel sgar la phyin pas tag tag bod sbod 'ga' zhig sgar shul du lcags rjen mar lus yod pa dang / za chas nas phyur ba tshang ma dbyug yod pa red/ de gar khorang rmas tshabs phran bu ma gsos bar nyin lnga tsam lus yod pa dang / de'iring ro skor phyin pas/ ri la so pa sngon song mi gnyis dang chu 'thung bar 'gro mkhan rmas ma gsum de gar song med pa las de min tshang ma bsad pa'i ro yod pa dang dpon skar mthar gyi phu nga po dum bu mang po gtub yo da pa red/ dpon gyi thung mdas bsad pa min nam snyam pa'i nye 'gram mdun ngos su ha sa'i ro bzhi lnga yod pa dang / del thog mi brgyad posu bsad pa 'dra ba'i ring sar ha sa'i ro 10lhag tsam yod pa red/ de nas lha rga/yang chos 'phe4 sgar shul phyur ba dum zhig dang / bod sbod chag dum/ sbi me bcas 'khyog tsam 'khur nas tshur ḍi sdog yong bar laca nas spyang gis za grabs byed skabs/ sbi me g.yug pas ma skyon tsam dang / chu chen brgal dus dgra lhas bslab ltar byas pas chus ma khyer tsam byung rung / 'bri chutshu rir bya rog gi tshang yod sa'i brag 'og zhig tu nyal skabs bya rog 92

mang bo byung nas rub 'thog byas pa bcas lam dgra sna tshogs sgrol nas a mdo'i sne zin pa dang / de nas nag chur 'byor thub nas byang spyir snyan seng zhus pa bcas so/ 'dir bgres song a mdo'i mgar ba dbang rnam (srid gros u yon )nas zer na/ che 'bum gyi skad ngan shod mi nag chur byang spyi'i mdun bcar skabs nga der yod pa dang / skabasader so dmag de tsho gsod mkhan su yin mi shes pa dang / byang spyi ra sa rgya rgan nas phal cher rgya mis bsad pa yin gyi red/ da rgya mi thon nyer yod pas byang dmag 800ang bsar byed dgos zer nas gra sgrig byas pa red/ de rjes gnas tshul thos rgyu med pa dang / gtsang rgyud kyi a mdor dgra rgyag kyang byas pa red/ der byang spyis so dmag dgra shor gyi gnas tshul rtog zhib byed pa dang / dgra lan chabs cig byang rigs dmag brgyad brgya 'gro dgos zer bar mda' tshab bar tha'i jing ger 'tsher snang byas te/ byang dmag brgyad brgyas byang so'i dgra lan ma 'phrod gong mi ser thog brdab gsig dang / nang khul kha chag sna ral yong dwogs kyis byang spyir a mdo'i dmag gtso bo byas pa'i rta pa brgya skor zhig ngas 'go byas te 'gro na 'grigs pa las da res thog mar tshang ma 'khrid kyang dge mtshan mi che zhus par de thog tu babs/ bar tha'i jing gir gyis dga' snang byed kyi 'dug lcags stag bod zla pa'i nangache 'bum so dmag dgra shor rjes lcags yos bod zla 1pa'i nang nga tsho gtsangargyud la 'gro zhor che 'bom so dmag bsad par rtog zhib byed par phyin pas ba yan 'dor ma'i stag lung du sdeb bsad byung ba'i mgo rus 93

dang / 'dor ma'i mtshal btsag sgye mo'i nang blug blug pa dang / ri dwags brgyab pa'i rus pa bcas gang sar khyab bsdad 'dug pa mig mthongabyung ste de skor gtsang rgyud la'ang ta sa'i jag bcom 'khel 'dug pa dang / ha sa rta pa dum zhig so ca/'i rgyud la gtad nas phyin pa mthong 'dug pas/ che 'bum gyi so dmag dgra la shor ba de gsod mkhan dgra ha sa yin pa gzhi nas shes pa red/ de'i sngon gyi lo 'ga' zhig gong byang rigs kyi byang so'i 'go pa dpa' bo sri thar gyis byed pa'i dus nga dang / nga'i a khus gtsos a mdo'i so dud lnga bcas kyi 'bri mar glang sna'i so sa ru ha sa mi 12yod pa'i dud 'chal re gnyis shig byung bar mgo skor nas tshang ma bsad pa dang / ha mo gcig 'bri chu thon nas shor ba red/ che 'bum gyi so dmag gsod lugs nan po dang /gnag po yin pa 'di'i snying nad yin kyang srid ces zer/(5) khral bun 'bam tshong sogs kyis rkyen am stod kyi sde byang byolabyas pa/ a mdo stod ma de bzhin khral 'bab lci la khral rgyugs yul nag rdzong dang 'gyangs thag ring ba/ khyim dud mang che bar lo ltar byang bskyod byed goms yod pa/ sa mtha'i mi ser lkugs shas che la btsan po'i rgyag rdung dang gshe gshe bzod mi thub pa bcas kyis rkyen pas/ sa tshigs sgug res sogs rgyun ldan chad lus mang bas ru mi dang / sa rgan tshos rdzong dang / bla brang che gras/ tshong pa che khag bcas las bu lon mi len rka med byung zhing / bun bdag tshos ske gnya' rdog rdzis zer ba'i dpe ltar dngul dod bal mar 'bri g.yag sprod dan rin gong 94

kho tshos gang bshad de nyan gyi gtan 'khel gan 'jog bun 'jal byed kyin du mun bun che ru che ru 'gro bzhin yod/ nag rdzong byang spyi ru bsgyur rjes de bas bun cher gyur pa dang / byang spyi pha lha dang gsum mdo ba gnyis brje skabs de gnyis la chad pa'i bu lon rnams byang spyi gsar pa lha rta dang / zhwa sgab gnyis la ga sgyur byas pa ma zad/ gsar pa gnyis kyi sa nas kyang sngar bzhin bu lon len dgos byung zhing / gsar rnying sdom pa'i lhan bzhi sbrel gyi bu lon zer ba zhig chags nas rgya 'ub mi 'dus ba'i skabs der/ a stod dpon rgan tshos gan rgya zhig shor ba'i nang don gtso bo/ shog kha de yongs kyi lug bal sbo spu tsam phyir gyar med pa lo bstud mar byang spyir bu lon sprod rgyu dang / de las 'gal te lug b.lanyo tshong byas rigs mtshis tshe/ nyo tshong pa phyogs gnyis kor nyes bkod mig lar 'dom nges gcod rgyu'i skor 'khod yod/ de dang chabasacig shog kha tshogs sa dang mi ser sdod yul kha shas su byang spyi'i sku tshab dang / dmag mi 'gro skyod mang du 'gro ba dang de tshos mi ser gyi khrod du khrimayomed lugs med ngo tsha khrel bral za 'dod bsnyad gtser sna tshogs byas par brte na skabs 'gar mi ser kha shas kyis gyen log gis me mda' dbyin ji kha thung 'phrog pa dang / rgyag rdung byas pa'i gnas tshul yang yong gi yod pa red/ 1947bod me phag lo'i skor mi ser 'ga' zhig gis gyen rgol byed shugs che ru phyin nas tshong khag kha shasal bal lkog tshong brgyab pa dang / bal ri la sbas pa sogs byas pa ma zad/sku tshab nag po la skrag rgyu med/ rang rgyu rang la mi dbang pa'i rgyu mtshan 95

gang yin sogs brjod kyi yod pa la brten byang spyi'i ngo tshab drag rim dang / sku srung dmag mang po shog kha tshogs sa mtsho dmar sa char yong nas bca' sdod byas pa dang dus mtshungs gang sar rtogs zhib kyang byed kyi yod pas/ byang spyi dang am stod bar gnas tshul rdza drag tu gyur gyi yod pa red/ skabs der mi ser khrod nas gtso gras re zung gis 'go byas khyim dud brgya lhag tsam byang phyogs sa zur la dngos su thon te gyen log gis rgol gtam bshad par/ byang spyi gsar rnying gis ri bo tsam zas pas ma 'grangs/ rgya mtsho tsam btung bas ma ngoms par nga tsho sa mtha'i khral pa nyam chung rnams khral chad mtha' ma srog la gtugs/ ko ba mtha2 zos dkyil la gtugs/ 'breng pa sne zos 'gug la gtugs shing dus da nas bzung / lag khrims lcag can gyi dpon po dang / 'go lcang lo can gyi bod pa tsho/ sa dkar dmar gram gsum la shog dang a nga rlung bsil mas bar 'dum byed/ mda' nyan phran gyis 'brel ba byed sa dkar dang dmar dang gram dang gsum/ de phan chad sa la sa ming med/ de phan chad mi la dpon g.yog med/ nga tsho ni sa lkuḍa nang gi mi lkuḍa/ mi lkugs glan pa blo gcig yin zhes 'phrin yig bzhag nas byang mthar skyod kyi yod pa'i skabs der byang spyis thabs gzhan zhig btsal nas am stod kyi dpon dang 'brel ba byas te slad sku tshab dpon dmag am stod kyi sa gnas su mi yong ba'i khas len dang yul byol pa tsho/ nag med zhi 'gug gi thabs shes bzos pa red/ 'on kyang bu lon zugs pa sngar mus bzhin las leḍacha gang yang ma thon par mu mthud 'jal dgos kyi yod pa red/96

(ca—) gser rdung khram skor gtor ba/ sngon gsang gzhung sger tsho gsum gyi gras gser rdung dkar ru'i 'go pa gser rdung sbra chen tshang zer ba der bu med stabs bu mo kun bzang dbang mo la mag pa 'dam gzhung nas yin pa'i chos skyabs zer ba zhig blangs rjes 'dam la gnyen 'phrad 'gro zhor dang / 'bri gung 'pho ba chen mo mjal zhor stabs cig yin zhes shing sprel/ 19444 skor 'ad ma la byen pa ca/ de gar lha skyod khams pa ba rma si ti bla brang gi ja bdal blangs pa'i ja pa zhig dang 'phrad par go mag chos skyabs can dpon g.yog kha shas nas mtshan rdib kyis si ti bla brang gi bdal dpon mi 3bsad nas ja khal ma 14༷steng zong 'og khalatshang ma bcom 'khrog byas nas stod la yul col du lo shas phyin/de rjes mar log nas su rong du gnas bcas te bsdad pa dang (da lta lha ri shan su rong chus )slar stod jag song nas mdzod sbug gi she 'bri 100skor jag 'ded byas khar/ nam rgyun kun jag gi las la brten nas sdod pas mi tsho4gser rdung khram skor ram gser rdung skor ba zhes 'bod/ me phag 1940lor byang spyi lha'u rta ra'i skapas sdon du mdzod sbug she 'bri jag 'ded shor ba'i she 'dzin sde dpon gyis lha sar snyan zhu phul bar brten ba7'a shag srid ba/zhung nas byang spyi lha rta dang zhwa sgab par gser rdung khram skor gtor dgos pa'i bka' phabs par/byang spyi lha rta nas brgya dpon bco lnga tshe ring gtso 4pa'i bod dmag 150dang / byang rigs dmag nyung ngu bcas phar lam rma'i thi rgyud nas phyin thog su rong gser rdung gi thog tu mtshan mo skor nas nam gsal ba 97

dang lhan du dung ba rda gto nga bzhin bskor rdung btang te khyon mi suca/ cu bsad de gser rdung skor ba zer ba rtsa med btang / mag pa chos skyabs nas bod dmag 5bsad/ bu mos kun bzang dbang mo dang / tsha bo spos khrug gnyis bros shor ba sde nang du gab par sdes thog 'jog byas te bsad 'dzin bzung byas pa pho mo bdun brgyad yod/ nor 100lhag dang /rta 10lhag sbra dang khyim gzhis rtsis len gyis tshur lam gsang gzhung rgyud nas yong / nag chur sle bas pa dang / mgo lag 31rdzong gi rgya sgor la btags nas khrims rngams ston/ rjes su 'dzin bzung byas pa'i pho mode tshor zog dum zhig sprad nas rang yul du mngaḍa/ brgya dpon bco lnga sogs la dpa' dar gnang nas gser rdung khram skor ming gi lhag mar gyur te mjug sgril/ de min gong du ma gsal ba'i byang spyi'i skabs kyi bya ba kha shas brjod na (1) byang spyi pha lha'i skabs lo zhig gi dpyid nar gser rnyed chu ba sal byed skabs sgrub bla'i mi ser dang / kun gling mi ser la khral rgyug ma dgos pa'i bka' gtan gzhir bzung bla brang gnyis kyi mo yan chu bsal las 7/ra skul ma dgos pa zhes pha lha'i sku ngor bcar zhu byas par don son yong rgyu lta ci zhu mkhan mo yan 'go pa gnyis la rta lcag brgya re zhus rjes sgrung bla'i gnyer pa dar 'dzin gyi zhu nan u tshugs che drags pas de yang bzung grabs byas par/ bsam gtan sprul skus gtso byas zhabs dgon gyi grwa pa rnams 'ur rtsis byas pa byang spyi pha lhas rtogs rjes gzhi nas bskyel khra zhus te 'jam po'i sgo nas thag gcod byung ba red zer rgyu 'dug (3) 'ing sprel 1944lor byang spyi pha lha sa 98

phebs kyis zhabs dgon dngos skyong gi dbu bla mdzad pa dang / snga rting gi a mdo shog brgyad khongs kyi dgon pa phyag 'de bar dang mtshan 'dzin dbu bla gnang ba de nas bzung ser byes sgrub khang sprul sku de byang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me zhig la ngos bzung byed/ 93bas dgon ni ma dgon dang / a mdo'i dgon khag rnan/sa bu dgon lta bur brtsi gi yod 'dug tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar par rnying nang du rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo 34ste sa bya 1909por mes rgyal nas byang lam rgyud bod skyod gnang dus thog tho'i chu thon gyi phebs lam nas nag chu'i sgrub khang spru la sku dang / byang dgon khag bcu yi spyi 'thus las sne bcas nas phebs bsu'i mjal dar phul na sa 'khod 'dug la dgon khagabacu po ni/ zhabs brtan dgon pa dang / rong po dgon/shog chen sgrol sku dgon/ chos gling dgon/ stag reng dgon/ o rtog thar gling dgon/ thang skad dgon/ gna' mo dgon/ am stod brag dkar dbon/ 'brong ngur dgon bcas ming gsal 'dugaphra tshang la steng du phebs skabs chibs bsu la ke'u tshang shar sprul sku/ bcobargyad sprul sku/ kham lung sprul sku/ o tog sprul sku/ stag ring spru la sku / rong po sbru lke/ sku gnyis/ 'brong dgon sprul sku bcas 'khod 'dugagazhan yang 'di'i dus byang rigs sde bzhis rta dmag gi ru sgrig te phebs bsu byas tshul yang 'dub/ gong du bgra nga pa'i dgon pa'i khar da dung dge lugaru/ grub mtha' ri dgon du ma snga rting gis chags dar byung ba bzhin/ khyon byang rigs tsho pa'i khongs su grub mtha' rmi 'dra ba'i 122

mdo'i rgyud la tog tsam grags pa las che gras kyi zhabs dgon dang / rong po dgon sogs la rjes sor mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs la tsam las rig gnas kyi phyogs gzhan kun nas dbul ba zhig yin ba ni rgyu yi ldog zlar gyur/ 'on kyang rang lugs kyi cho ga phyag len gyis mtshon pa'i gan sa kun la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa tshar longs yong bzhin yod pa red/ byang dgon so so'i chags gnas der gnas ri byen can lta bu yin tshul mang tsam gleng rgyu yod/ 'on te zhabs brtan dgon pa chags sa 'di byin can yin tshul ge sar sgrung nasa'adren pa tsam las shod mkhan mi 'dug kyang tā la bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar nang 'di ltar 'khodayod pa ‘‘sa bya hor zla dang po'i tshes 14nyin zhabs dgon sman sgrub kyi gar 'cham la thugs zhib legasapar mdzad de 'cham rol pa rnams la dar dkar gyi skyes 'tshems med rtsal/ byang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me sgrub khang sprul sku rin po che nyid zhwa nag gi chas su zhugs nas gsang ba thun mong min pa'i phrag mchod kyi cho ga gyer skabs gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i dag pa'i gzigs snang la phyogs mtshams kun nasaḍa ki pho mo dang / zhing skyong sde brgyad kyi tshogs chen po rnams nam mkhar mi shong ba lta bu 'dus nas rag ta'i rachod par dngos su rol ba zhig byung ba'i gnas de yul nyer bzhi'i ya gyal du grags pa bden bzhes gsungs pa zhabs dgon gyi las byed rgan pa dag gi gleng ngo ’’zhes so/ byang rigs 'dir sngar nas ched mngaḍa sam lam rgyud zhor phebs kyi bla chen chos 'brel yod pa tā la'i sku phreng bdun pa/ bcu gsum pa/ bcu bzhi pa/ paṇa chen sku 124

phreng drug pa/ dgu pa/ bcu pa/ rgyal zuro rwa sgreng / de bachin sa skya bdag chen gyi gdung sras dang / smim gling khri chen/ kocho/ pa sku phreng kha shas/ stag lung ma sbru la bcas byung yod la/ so ga po dang a mdo'i phyogs nasamakhar kha rje btsun dam pa dang / lcang skya ho thog thu kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs kyang phebs skyo da lam bar gyi chos 'brel yod/ de min gdan sa khag nasaphri la sku 'bring khag gzhan mang po yo da la bar tha'i bon por dad mkhan sar sman ri mkhan po 'am/ gshen dang zhu g.yas bla khag phebs kyi yod/ de bzhin gsham 'og nasakyar byang rigs tsho khul du 'bul sdud dam da7/ra thog yong mkhan sna tshoḍa te/ dper na 'bri gungadung tshong zer ba/ sa skya'i 'bul sdod zer ba/ tsa ri tshus pa zer ba/ ka 'og sngags pa zer ba sogs lo ltar rdzogs rgyu med pa slebs yong gi yod/ byang dgon so so la ban de bu khral dgon sde'i bka' gtan btsan — los la bzhigs nas tsho shog so sos sgrub dgos pa dang / bu gsum 'bring po zeng ba yin/ 'dir zhabs dgon dang rong po dgon gnyis dmigs bsal dbang cha che ba dang / lhag par tā la'i bcu gsum pa dang / sgrub khang lnga pa thugs snang gshin par brten zhabs dgon nas gang zhus ltar sa gnas srid gzhung gis dang len byed kyi yod 'dugadagon pa 'di gnyis dbar stod sgor gyi grwa pa'i skor 'then rtsod zlos gyar phran bu yang byung yod 'dug dgon so so'i chos rgyun gyi gtong rtsa rnam dkar gyi dge rtsa zhes she 'chi med mtshon pa'i gtong thebs rnams mi ser— 125
